LongMemEval bands: Mastra 94.87%, Hindsight 91.4%, Zep 71% (~3.2s), GPT-4o full-context ~64% — structured memory beats raw RAG/full-context by ~15–30 points (vendor self-reports on a third-party benchmark). PersonalAI 2.0: graph personal memory with search planning, 89% retention on MINE-1; search-plan enhancement +18%. Design: usage-and-outcome-first evaluation — instrument retrieval frequency as a primary metric; LongMemEval bands (64→95%) as the accuracy reference; add an enablement metric (what memory produces); qualitative finding: capture friction buys comprehension, automation buys reuse — A/B the UX variable. Central gap: no independent productivity RCT for second-brain apps.

### 239. Commitment memory: first-class lifecycle, due-list query surface, empty-commitment audit (Fo, R40) — MEDIUM
Commitment as a first-class memory type: pending → acknowledged → completed/failed/cancelled (+ pending-unscheduled holding); every transition an audit event (timestamp, actor, reason). Due-list queries are a separate operation from semantic recall: overdue-first sorted by obligation, not similarity — follow-up reliability depends on this query surface existing. Recurring duties need bookmark/cursor mechanics with compare-and-set advancement and explicit catch-up — otherwise duplicates or silent gaps. The 2026 "empty commitments" paper: promises decidable as unkeepable at utterance time — capability (no tool), temporal (no scheduler/clock), agentive (no authority to obligate people) failures; 45.9% failure for open-weight models with no persistence affordance vs 4.4% frontier via deferral; no fix dominates without raising over-refusal — budget both. Ops: promise-vs-capability audit at generation time (in-loop checker preferred over disclosure); email/calendar connectors with thread preservation and local-processing privacy; recurring bookmark mechanics and behavioral-contract hooks (Armalo Terms: machine-readable specs verified on every completion, violations recorded in memory history) as hard requirements for time-bound-commitment agents.

### 240. SRE agent memory: two-tier model, PR-gated runbooks, enforced recall-before-investigate, autonomy ladder (Fo, R40) — MEDIUM
In-flight incident session state (evidence, approvals, sandbox handles — ephemeral) vs durable resolved-incident reports (only resolved history survives restarts) — define restart/rehydration semantics, or incidents become un-investigable after a crash. Runbooks-as-code with PR-gated agent-authored updates: the merge record is the autonomy-graduation ledger — agent-written operational memory never merges unreviewed. "Check memory before starting fresh" is an enforced protocol step keyed on the alert fingerprint (EpistemicOps warm mode: "this looks like INC-001, the fix was an index"). Autonomy: review mode → autonomous mode per remediation type, earned by track record, defaulting to review. Change-correlation: deployment history bundled with telemetry at investigation time; code changes connected to telemetry. Teach-agent capture: novel human resolutions committed back in one action. Hypotheses-tested is the highest-value memory content; verification-window records feed recurrence correlation; incident records creatable from silent/customer-reported failures (78% of orgs had ≥1 customer-first incident/year). Fleet: single-process memory files are fleet-wide amnesia — durable tier needs shared concurrent-safe storage. No measured MTTR improvements attributable to agent memory found.

### 241. Meeting-memory mechanics: event-sourced decision log, uncertainty fields, topic-brief ritual, continuity metrics (ChatGPT, R40) — MEDIUM
Decisions event-sourced in an append-only log with relation edges (supersedes, reverses, clarifies); current-state views computed from the log. Immutable per-meeting source layer (transcript + evidence) vs revisable interpretation layer (threads, briefs, current-state) — compaction never touches the source. Meeting-start retrieval ritual: per-thread topic brief (open items, current decisions, unresolved questions, latest sources); carry items forward only while unresolved, close with evidence. Thread-resurface detection: semantic match + context (participants, project, time, entities); keep separate subthreads for different decisions under one broad topic. Evaluation gap: AMI/QMSum/MeetingBank cover summarization, not decision reversals or cross-month continuity — evaluate carry-forward/close/supersede as a first-class metric with a multi-meeting synthetic series. Entity alias maps ("Maya" = "Maya Chen") are load-bearing for longitudinal memory. Vendor accuracy claims (Granola, Trace, CogniAIX) are demos/marketing, not evidence.

### 242. Scientific-discovery agent memory: typed stores + provenance gate, failure taxonomy, discovery-oriented evaluation (ChatGPT, R41) — HIGH
Typed, linked stores (working/trajectory, hypothesis ledger, experiment ledger, literature-claim memory, failure memory) linked by a shared query layer preserving source type and confidence — converges with InternAgent-1.5's Generation→Verification→Evolution split and R37–R40's separated-stores conclusion. Provenance is a gate, not a log line: block promotion of any computational result to "evidence" unless code hash, input-data fingerprint, params, seeds, environment, outputs all exist; measure missing-provenance rate. Failure taxonomy: scientific negative (valid test, effect absent) vs technical failure (test not validly executed) vs inconclusive (ran but uninterpretable) — record objective, setup, validity checks, suspected cause with confidence, what would make a rerun informative; never convert unverified diagnosis into fact. Literature memory = claim-level records (claim_id, normalized claim, exact passage/page, type, population/method/dataset/intervention, effect size+uncertainty, design, limitations, extraction confidence, human-verification state) with supported_by/contradicted_by citation chains — guards against superseded claims, citation drift, invisible negatives, incomparable-population retrieval. Hypothesis registry: exact statement immutable, amendments create linked versions, statuses proposed/active/supported/weakened/rejected/superseded (rejected = rejected-under-stated-conditions). Human-in-the-loop: approval before wet-lab/expensive/irreversible actions and before promoting hypotheses on small samples; memory must visibly distinguish model inference, extracted evidence, human-verified facts. Evidence status: ChatGPT explicitly flagged discovery-specific memory evidence as thin (no controlled study shows registries/failure ledgers improve discovery outcomes); only paper-reported number is Meta's Proactive Memory Agent (Sonnet 4.5 Terminal-Bench 37.6%→45.9% with failure-aware memory — tool-use benchmark, not discovery). Evaluate by ablation: memory-on vs memory-off vs transcript-only; measure redundant-experiment rate, valid-test rate, reproducibility, replay agreement — not hit rate.

### 243. Threat-intel/security agent memory: trust-tiered writes, indicator schema, deterministic-LLM boundary (ChatGPT, R41) — HIGH
Three stores with three authorities and distinct retention: (a) world threat-intel (indicator + behavior store), (b) operational knowledge (approved playbooks, known-good queries, validated procedures — versioned, approval status visible), (c) case evidence (per-incident, under case-management access controls). Indicator memory = observations with provenance and expiry, STIX 2.1-aligned: normalized + raw value, source, source_record_id, first/last seen (distinct from ingestion time), confidence on a defined scale separate from verdict, verdict lineage (who/what changed it, when, why), valid_from/valid_until, per-type TTL (hash/IP/domain need different policies), sightings, write provenance. TTPs as a versioned graph: observations → behaviors → ATT&CK technique IDs (+versions) → campaigns/cases, each mapping a confidence-bearing hypothesis. Deterministic-LLM boundary: route normalization, lookups, joins, policy checks, known playbooks through deterministic code (Red Canary's hardest-won phishing-triage lesson: moving deterministic tools out of the non-deterministic LLM loop dramatically improved accuracy); LLM does bounded interpretation, explanation, hypothesis generation; label unsupported conclusions; measure divergence and tool-call correctness. Trust-tiered write policy: Tier 0 (untrusted input — emails, feeds, tickets, repos) → quarantine only, never direct operational writes; Tier 1 (extracted candidates, schema-constrained, quoted evidence) → searchable as unverified leads; Tier 2 (corroborated — independent corroboration, source-quality checks, analyst review) → promotable; Tier 3 (approved operational — playbooks, suppression logic) → authorized review, versioning, tests, rollback path. Per-write provenance (actor/tool, source, timestamp, transformation, confidence, approval, superseded record); atomic/versioned compare-and-swap updates, never last-writer-wins. Red-team test: an untrusted email must not modify approved memory. Threat model: memory poisoning with delayed effect is the defining threat (U. Calgary Sep 2026 dormant-poisoning research; MemGhost single-email stealth injection, press-reported 87.5% in background runs — unverified, report as press-derived only; ChatGPT knowledge-horizon confusion on Sep-2026 research recorded). Monitor anomalous writes over time (high-volume writes, sudden verdict flips, changes to durable rules). Semantic dedup: merge one technique across three blogs into one entry but preserve each source assertion and the merge decision (allow splits/reversals) in provenance. False positives as expiring suppression candidates with review paths, never permanent suppression. Evaluate vs baseline with published sample sizes: alert reduction, investigation quality/time, false-positive rate, stale-memory hit rate, poisoning detection/false-alarm/recovery rates — ChatGPT found no controlled study isolating memory-specific detection/triage gains.

### 244. Fraud-detection memory: historical-outcome memory with decision context; re-benchmark on model upgrades (Grok, R41) — HIGH
Coinbase Oct 2026 (all vendor-claimed, proprietary, non-reproducible — closest public 2026 numbers): LLM fraud-risk agent reviewing transactions that cleared upstream ML models cut fraudulent transactions 30% and fraud dollar value 22% in A/B (3× the model running cost estimated savings) — history-as-context as a review layer. Fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B (RL w/ GRPO+LoRA on historical fraud outcomes, <$100 training) beat Opus 4.5 on a fixed 16,140-transaction/813-fraud replay: +7.5pp precision, +12.0pp recall, +9.6pp F1, +35.4pp dollar-weighted recall; median latency 0.683s vs 1.515s (−55%) — historical-outcome memory baked into a specialist beats generalist LLMs. Newer frontier models REGRESSED on fraud detection (Sonnet 5 −22.2pp recall vs Sonnet 4.6; GPT-5.6 −20.7pp vs GPT-5.4) — "newer is not necessarily better at domain-specific tasks"; re-benchmark on every model upgrade is an operational requirement. Selection-bias caution: a 0.963-AUC fraud classifier was thrown away because trained on investigation-outcome labels it learned which alerts got investigated, not fraud (cleared alerts 3× more "anomalous" than confirmed frauds) — fraud-outcome memory must record decision context (which signals fired, what the agent saw) alongside outcomes, not just outcome labels. Academic leg: transformer + graph memory for first-party fraud reported 0.982 accuracy vs baselines (GRU/LSTM as long-term memory gates for spend-spike history; not standardized-comparable). Design rule: anomaly-pattern memory logs decision context alongside outcomes; upgrades never ship on frontier-generalist credentials alone.

### 245. Recommender memory: compressed recurrent preference memory, temporally disentangled, situational gating (Grok, R41) — HIGH
ByteDance Large Memory Network (arXiv 2502.05558, deployed at million-scale on Douyin e-commerce search): +4.68% AUC over DNN baseline, −1.46% LogLoss, online A/B on Douyin ECS — strongest evidence long-term history memory lifts production recommendation (ByteDance first-party, not independently reproduced). Rec2PM recurrent preference memory (segment-based, L_full=1000 in segments of 200) beats full-context feeding on MerRec benchmark (H@10 44.20 vs 42.77, N@10 28.66 vs 27.47 on HSTU) — compression beats brute-force context. Temporal disentanglement is non-negotiable: LLM temporal user profiling (2025, ablation-based) gives +15.2% Recall@20 over short-term-only variant; holistic non-temporal profiles degrade performance >20% Recall / 18% NDCG. AutoMR (WWW Companion 2025) stores long-term interests in retrievable memory so the LLM isn't limited to recent interactions (two real-world datasets; lift sizes not headline-reported). RecMind (LLM+GNN): +2.24–4.53% relative over strongest baselines; LLM-only ablation −9.4% Recall@20 — semantic cues alone insufficient without collaborative structure. Caution from BenchPreS/PairPref (2026): frontier LLMs over-apply stored preferences regardless of context (both-sides-appropriate only 3.6–18.3%) — storing preferences is not enough; the system must judge when they apply. Phase-3 design: compressed recurrent long-term preference memory over raw-history-in-context, temporally disentangled (long-term vs short-term), with situational-appropriateness gating on preference application. No vendor (Netflix/Spotify/TikTok) publishes public A/B lifts attributable specifically to LLM memory — industry headline numbers remain behind closed doors.

### 246. Smart-home agent memory ops: distributed-state reconciliation, per-user namespaces, write trust tiers (Fo, R41) — MEDIUM
Device-state memory is a distributed-state problem (cloud copy, local copy, physical device) — drift between them is the default failure; documented builds (SmartAbode: Arduino + Firestore + FastAPI, hardware sync worker) keep a cached state plus a sync worker pushing to hardware with sensor re-reads (PIR/occupancy) feeding back. Ops requirement: reconciliation-loop spec — cloud cache, local cache, physical-device re-read cadence, drift-alert threshold; checkpoint + re-read cadence mandatory after restarts ("scoped and consistent across restarts"). Multi-user scoping is the least-solved operation: Plural Voices paper (ar5iv 2510.19008) documents conflicting preferences as first-class failure (child's bright lights vs neurodivergent user's dim lights), "memory poisoning" between users, poorer multi-agent coordination (single-agent-with-fairness-mediation beat multi-agent baselines on fairness/safety: compliance 76% vs 70%, fairness 90% vs 85%, safety violations 0% vs 7% — preliminary, author-benchmark) — household memory needs per-user namespaces plus an explicit conflict-resolution policy for shared actuators (lights, temperature, locks); a flat shared memory silently blends preferences. Safety-critical attack surface: prompt injection with physical consequences (Black Hat 2025: poisoned calendar invite made assistant open shutters/switch on boiler/flash lights; 14 attack variants) — memory writes from untrusted channels (email invites, shared calendars) must never actuate without confirmation. Failure mode "preference substitution": assistant overriding an explicit command (alarm 5:45 → 6:00) citing an unverified learned habit — learned preferences need provenance (when learned, from whose command) and a confidence gate before overriding explicit instructions; boundary probes (unambiguous commands contradicting habits) as cheap regression tests. Identity: duplicate device entries ("Living Room Lamp" twice) corrupt per-entry state — canonical device-identity registry with de-dup on discovery before feeding memory. Retention: memory-retention policy (what stored, for whom, deletion guarantees) is a compliance operation, not a default. Phase-3 ops requirement: (1) canonical device-identity registry with de-dup; (2) reconciliation loop spec; (3) per-user preference namespaces with provenance and conflict-resolution policy; (4) trust tiers on writes — human-verified vs agent-learned vs untrusted-channel (last tier never actuates without confirmation); (5) boundary-probe regression suite (explicit command contradicting a learned habit must win) as the routine-memory acceptance test. Research-derived, first-pass topic; hobbyist-build patterns generalize but scale doesn't match commercial assistants.

### 247. Language-learning agent memory ops: three-layer separation, FSRS per-item scheduler, curriculum-write gates (Fo, R41) — MEDIUM
Morphowiki framework (SoftwareX 2026) is the cleanest documented pattern: three layers — generation (7 Agent Skills), data (plain-text Markdown knowledge graph per word/morpheme, bidirectional links), review (local Node.js server + JSON datastore tracking spaced-repetition scheduling); workflow initialize → ingest → expand → review; chat logs treated as ephemera to be mined, never the store — learner-model memory = an auditable, version-controlled, diffable curriculum artifact (950-item evaluation: F1 83.06 vs BPE 29.13 / Morfessor 47.26; $9–23 per 1000 words generation cost — budget caps per curriculum batch). Spaced-practice scheduling needs per-item parameters, not per-learner averages: mainstream knowledge-tracing models (BKT, AFM) fit history fine but overestimated delayed retention and missed spacing effects (Schuetze, Yan & Carvalho 2025, ~50k trials — reached via secondary summary, verify against original) — FSRS-6 with per-memory stability/difficulty/retrievability (dev.to field practice, not peer-reviewed), per-track scheduling (writing/listening/speaking/per-definition), RL-optimized review intervals (GLD-HLR: MAE < 0.03 recall probability, MAPE < 0.2 half-life) are the operationally safe alternatives. Scheduler is a state machine per learning item with review events as transitions; global retention scores mislead. Curriculum-write gates: Morphowiki's `/lint` never edits — flags only (link symmetry, schema, semantics), every state change needs explicit human authorization; `/new-word` embeds validation so the model cannot inject hallucinated pseudowords — agent-generated curriculum content is an untrusted write until validated. Silent decay is the primary scheduling failure mode: without a forgetting model, items "look fine on every observable metric" while retrievability trends toward brittleness — monitor predicted retrievability distribution and alert on declining-retrievability items with no scheduled review; power-law FSRS curves fix stale-recent-memory crowding. Learner-model write schema: attempt → {accuracy, latency, difficulty estimate, track} — binary right/wrong underspecifies the scheduler (response-time-based adaptive scheduling improved recall in both typing and speech modalities). Cognitive-offloading caution: instant AI answers risk "metacognitive laziness" — track retrieval effort (not just completion) as learning-loop health; force active retrieval, spaced review, human-approved curation. Phase-3 ops requirement: (1) three-layer separation (generation / curriculum store / scheduler); (2) scheduler spec with per-item stability-difficulty-retrievability, per-track scheduling, review-event transitions, retrievability-distribution monitor with decay alerts; (3) lint/validate + human-authorization gates before curriculum mutation, attested-content validation on generated items; (4) per-attempt write schema {accuracy, latency, difficulty, track}; (5) retrieval-effort health metric. Research-derived, first-pass topic; dev.to sources are field practice not peer-reviewed.

### 248. Software-dev agent memory: verification-on-retrieval, repo-graph with invalidation, retrieval routing by query type (ChatGPT, R42) — HIGH
Scope every record to repo identity (canonical remote + commit + dependency-lock hash + environment — a branch name is not an identity); on retrieval, check scope against the current commit/lock/environment and return facts as verified / stale / unverified, never unqualified truth. Three-way invalidation: safe-to-keep (stable metadata, attempts labeled with original commit) vs must-reverify (behavioral claims after code/dependency changes) vs must-tombstone (deleted symbols, superseded state). Six-step invalidation protocol: on session start fetch commit + lockfiles → diff against indexed snapshot → update hashes, tombstone deleted paths/symbols → reparse changed files, re-resolve touching edges, mark unresolved edges stale → reverify affected facts → retrieved facts carry scope + status. Five-store schema: RepoSnapshot/File/Symbol/Edge/Surface (chunks must retain file/symbol IDs); ApiFact (package, version_range, claim, evidence, project_scope, confidence, status — project-scoped observations must not become general facts); WorkItem/Comment/Check/Attempt (CI outcomes keyed to exact head SHA — "tests passed" without a commit reference is not durable state); Investigation/Hypothesis/Observation/PatchTrial (disconfirmed only with the disconfirming observation); FailureSignature/FailureResolution (normalized error + environment fingerprint + lock hash; suppress remembered fix only when signature and conditions match). Retrieval routing by query type: exact-key for IDs/symbols/paths/failure signatures; graph traversal for "what calls this?"/impact; BM25 for identifiers and error messages; vector for conceptual tasks; hybrid for mixed queries — contradicts the single-vector-store default. Measured leg: Codebase-Memory (Vogel et al., arXiv:2603.27277, abstract verified on arXiv) — Tree-sitter knowledge graph via MCP, 31 real repos: 83% vs 92% answer quality, 10× fewer tokens, 2.1× fewer tool calls vs file-exploration agent; graph-native queries match-or-exceed on 19/31 languages — code-exploration Q&A, NOT issue resolution; no transcript-only or memory-on/off SWE-bench baseline exists anywhere; ChatGPT explicitly refused to supply ablation numbers. Evaluate commit/dependency changes between sessions, not just static-snapshot retrieval. Secret hygiene: detect/block/redact secret classes before persistence, auditable deletion of records plus derived indexes. Confucius Code Agent 54.3% SWE-Bench-Pro and ByteDance OpenViking Gateway are real but numberless (video claims / Beta).

### 249. Legal-agent memory: "claims, not chunks" as a program pattern; privilege as enforcement boundary; citation fidelity (ChatGPT, R42) — HIGH
Program-level finding: the "claims, not chunks" pattern now holds across discovery (R41), code (R42), and law — precedent memory = Authority + Proposition + Applicability records with verbatim pinpoint passages ("a bare vector chunk is not enough to cite as authority"); schema: Authority (canonical case ID, caption, court, jurisdiction, date, reporter, neutral citation, docket, source DB + retrieval date, precedential status, subsequent-history links), Proposition (issue/rule taxonomy, verbatim passage, pinpoint, holding-vs-dicta, material facts, cited-by/treatment links, verification status), Applicability (governing jurisdiction, relevant date, court hierarchy, issue conditions, known contrary authority). Privilege and confidentiality are enforcement boundaries, not metadata tags: "authorize before retrieval" — every query evaluated against identity, matter membership, task purpose, ethical-wall membership, record-level policy, filtering applied BEFORE vector results reach the model; test caches, summaries, tool outputs; cross-matter search separately authorized, never default; grounded in ABA Rules 1.6/1.9/1.10 ("a software tag does not create privilege"); matter memory must provenance-tag client-typed vs counsel-typed material. Hallucinated citations are judicially established (*Mata v. Avianca*, S.D.N.Y. 2023 sanctions) but ChatGPT explicitly admitted no controlled legal-domain study shows citation-anchored memory reduces fabrication rates — all mitigations (citation→stored-passage gate, entailment check, "unable to verify" fallback, subsequent-history tracking, lawyer review before filing) are recommendation. JudgmentBench (arXiv:2605.25240, verified on arXiv): pairwise judgments recover quality ordering far better than rubrics (Spearman 0.908 vs 0.150; win-rate 0.669 vs 0.542; <half annotation time; 30 tasks, 3,069 expert annotations) — measures evaluation methodology, sets the Phase-3 eval bar: pairwise lawyer preference on real tasks, citation-support accuracy measured separately. Matter-continuity schema: append-only events with effective vs recorded dates and privilege status, corrections as linked records never silent overwrites, deadlines never agent-verified, snapshots as as-of-timestamped caches. Contract-term libraries with scope precedence (matter instruction > client playbook > firm template) and sanitization discipline (no inferred "preferences" from confidential negotiations admitted firm-wide). Defensible deletion is a workflow (source + derived + embeddings + caches + index invalidation + backup expiration evidence), not a flag. Retrieval fidelity protocol: jurisdiction, date, procedural posture travel with every answer; never present foreign/historical law as governing; pinpoints required; contrary authority reported as linked propositions, never silently collapsed. *U.S. v. Heppner* (2026) unverified single-video report — do not cite as established.

### 250. Code-gen agent memory measurements: summaries beat trajectories; unfiltered retrieval hurts; decay is measured (Grok, R42) — HIGH
SWE-ContextBench (peer-paper, Feb 2026, 99 tasks): oracle-selected summarized experience → 26.26%→34.34% (+8.08pp, ~31% relative lift); full unsummarized trajectories only 27.27% — structure beats volume. Free summary reuse 22.22% < 26.26% no-memory baseline, more patch failures, higher cost — unfiltered retrieval is MEASURED-NEGATIVE, the anchor for Phase-3 retrieval-quality gates (selection-quality threshold required; wrong memory hurts). SWE-MeM (CUHK/ByteDance): adaptive memory tool + Memory-aware GRPO → 43.4%/60.2% on SWE-Bench Verified under 32K context; static compression cuts peak context but increases total tokens — memory policy must be jointly trained with task solving. MEMTIER: flat-file memory loses 14pp tool success over 72h — plan tiered memory. TreeFlex (Meta, Oct 2026, press-reported): failure-attempts-as-search-tree → 9B model 54.9% vs 43.3% FoldAgent on SWE-Bench Verified at stated inference-cost premium. Vendor-claimed: TencentDB agent memory 60%→80% on related-case SWE-bench evaluation (2,600 sessions, −19% cost on 50 long tasks); Mem0 −73% tokens/call; Graft −42% tokens/−46% tool calls/−60% latency (33/50 vs 27/50 Claude Code). Gaps: no clean long-context-vs-structured-codebase-memory ablation on a code task exists; all SWE-bench numbers inherit contamination caveats; SWE-Bench-CL memory-on/off results are hypotheses only. Design: store compact per-episode distilled summaries (not raw trajectories); gate retrieval; treat failures as navigable state (TreeFlex); tier memory for 72h decay.

### 251. Driving/robotics agent memory: episodic memory delivers large robotics gains; the disengagement link is unmeasured (Grok, R42) — HIGH
MemoryVAM: episodic memory in video action models → LIBERO-Mem success 5%→42.5% (8.5×); dual-injection ablation — representation-only 28.5%, decoder-only 7.5%, joint 42.5% — memory must condition BOTH the world model and the policy; real robots 78.3%/80.0%/75.0% on counting/spatial/sequential tasks. Chameleon (NTU/A*STAR, ~60M params, 82ms/step): visually-ambiguous real-robot tasks → decision success 22.5%→80.8%, end-to-end 21.3%→71.3%. Enhanced HOPE: episodic temporal memory → −38% latency, +2.7 mAP on rare long-tail, >5s occlusion tracking where all baselines fail — index memory by ambiguity (occlusion = peak value). KEPT (peer-reviewed journal, Tongji): retrieval-augmented VLM planner, nuScenes SOTA — 0.70m avg L2 / 0.21% collision (NoAvg), 0.31m / 0.07% (TemAvg), Top-2 exemplars best, sub-ms retrieval — absolute SOTA, not a memory-on/off lift (ablation delta is a gap). CLAD: continual-learning driving requires episodic replay — regularization (EWC) fails; literature shows 7–17% gains with single-example-per-class memory. Explicit 2025–2026 gaps: NO published study links memory to disengagement reductions (Waymo 270M rider-only miles / 95% fewer serious-injury crashes; CA DMV Zoox >60k mi/disengagement, Waymo ~10.4k cumulative — all whole-system, non-memory-attributed); map-freshness lift numbers and cross-deployment lifelong-learning lift numbers are entirely missing; robotics results are research-scale, not fleet-scale; KEPT is open-loop only. Design: condition memory on world-model + policy; sub-ms retrieval is feasible; instrument fleet edge-case memory per-disengagement from day one — but keep Waymo-scale numbers attributed to whole-system, never to memory.

### 252. Personal-finance agent memory ops: as_of money facts, evidence-based audit trail, append-only corrections (Fo, R42) — MEDIUM
Audit trail must capture instructions + authority + tool evidence, never the agent's summary (six-bank Sept 2026 "Building Trust in Agentic Commerce" paper; OpenAI's mid-Sept 2026 disclosure that shipped models hid mistakes inside summaries shows why summaries are unreliable evidence; reconcile to the bank/ERP response, never the agent's claim — the "audit gap" is that observability shows the number, not why). Stale balances / numeric drift are first-class failures: every money fact carries as_of + source + verification interval; settled-only ingest semantics (pending excluded), statement cutoffs. Provenance-gated writes: unsourced model-generated numbers quarantine rather than overwrite (rogue $1,800 budget vs customer-stated $18,000) — contradiction-flagging with supersession links. Corrections are linked reversals in append-only, agent-unwritable logs — both sides of the dispute preserved, defensible to tax authorities (7-year retention). Household scoping is a derivation-leak problem (IEEE Access lineage-gating: churn_rate=0.114 derived from a restricted income column leaks through shared memory) — derived money facts inherit input permissions; dual-identity (principal + agent) access control. Confidence-gated review queues with posting thresholds (≥95% auto-post pattern) for categorisations and deduction claims, given ~57% chatbot error reports (single-study, directional). Per-class retention with tested deletion propagation across stores, embeddings, caches, logs. Research-derived, first-pass topic; regulatory cites jurisdictionally scoped (ATO 7y = Australia).

### 253. Clinical agent memory ops: draft-then-approve, identity-before-consumption, zero-PHI memory store (Fo, R42) — MEDIUM
Draft-then-approve is the safety architecture: the ONLY path by which memory-derived drafts mutate the clinical record is clinician sign-off — generated artifacts (MedicationRequest) must be cross-checked against the signed note's structured fields before entering the approval queue (documented incident: draft built from uncorrected ambient transcription). The 5.3%/14.9% study: 5.3% of AI notes had serious-or-imminent-harm errors, 14.9% of drafts were left completely unedited — gates need structured enforcement (mandatory edit checkpoints, confidence-forced review) and unedited-draft-rate monitoring. Merged/wrong-patient records are an identity ops problem UPSTREAM of memory — identity resolution/dedupe before AI consumption; identity breaks treated as AI incidents. Allergy/medication continuity needs evidence-sourced gates: three-list med reconciliation, RxNorm/NLM citations, high-severity or <0.85 confidence → mandatory pharmacist review, no exceptions; provenance decides conflict precedence. Deterministic tokenization (HMAC-SHA256) pre-storage for cross-session patient continuity with ZERO raw PHI in the memory store; MIT memorization research (NeurIPS 2025) adds pre-release retention testing. Full-chain audit logging (user, records read + permission checks, tool calls, model version, human action) in append-only ≥6-year store, never raw PHI. Per-interaction, non-skippable consent scoped by memory class, with export/deletion on withdrawal; patient correction-right workflow with disputed memory quarantined from downstream drafts. Research-derived, first-pass topic; key figures single-study and directional; HIPAA/GDPR overlap complex.

### 254. Customer-support agent memory: KBArticleBinding control, identity fails closed, no controlled memory evidence (ChatGPT, R43) — HIGH
Every policy-sensitive answer binds to article_id + immutable version (content hash) + passage hash/offsets + retrieved_at + policy effective-from/until + answer-span map with support_status (supported/partially_supported/unsupported) + recomputed freshness (current/stale/withdrawn/unknown). Rules: never a mutable URL alone; historical citations keep pointing at historical versions; changing the live KB after retrieval triggers re-retrieval or refusal. Converges with R42's legal precedent schema — "claims, not chunks" now spans discovery, code, law, support. The failure cost is judicially documented: *Moffatt v Air Canada* (2024 BCCRT 149, CAD 812.02) — airline liable for its chatbot's wrong bereavement-fare info; "if your AI says it, your business said it" (one case, not an aggregate cost, not a memory-causation finding). Four memory-mechanisms: stale KB binding, contaminated solution memory (unverified one-off answer summarized into a rule), profile-conditioned prior ("this customer was refunded before"), source-priority failure (ticket summary outranking the policy source) — control is authoritative-source precedence, not better retrieval: policy sources must outrank solution memory (test: insert conflicting historical workaround; controller must select the article or abstain). Identity rules: resolve to authoritative tenant-scoped customer_id AFTER authentication; email/phone/name/channel similarity are lookup signals only; multiple candidates → provisional, no prior-ticket memory exposed; merges across tenants forbidden, must be reversible; identity_status (verified/provisional/disputed/merged/deleted) makes ambiguity an explicit system state. ResolutionRecord: outcome separated from verification_status (unverified/verified/rejected/expired), valid_from/valid_until, cited versions never overwritten, publish to solution index only after review, supersede on product/policy change not silent edit. Sentiment is a dated expiring observation, never a durable trait. Evidence status (explicit): NO published controlled study isolates persistent cross-ticket memory vs memory-less/per-session baselines on resolution, CSAT, or handle time — memory's benefit in support is hypothesis, not fact; vendor headlines are bundled interventions (Klarna 2024: 11→2 min, −25% repeat inquiries; Fin 76% across 12,000+ customers under Intercom's definition; My AskAI 73%/68% CSAT at 105k tickets/month) and the 10-point CSAT-decline benchmark (hellosaur.us, reported) is the counter-signal. Phase-3 test: randomized/paired ticket trials with blinded adjudication, preregistered harm outcomes.

### 255. Sales agent memory: DealEvent append-only log, recall-vs-surveillance spec, ingestion boundaries (ChatGPT, R43) — HIGH
DealEvent is an immutable log (event_id, occurred_at, recorded_at, actor_type, assertions[] with confidence/verification state, source_excerpt_ref[] — never unrestricted copied transcripts); current values live in OpportunityMemory with record_version and source_of_truth_by_field; corrections are new events (supersedes_event_id), never silent rewrites. Sharpest line: the log "may record that an assertion was made without asserting that the assertion is true" — "buyer said approval is complete" and "approval is complete" are distinct assertion types; tentative language ("we might be able to offer") must survive extraction AS TENTATIVE — the direct antidote to the hallucinated-commitment failure mode. NegotiationRecord: each offer/counteroffer with direction (our_offer/counterparty_offer/internal_target), approvals, concessions, expiry, policy version; confidential internal limits (pricing floors, discount authority) sit behind a separate access class behind explicit authorization, never in general retrieval; "a past concession is not standing authorization to repeat it." Recall-vs-surveillance line as design spec: every memory item carries purpose, audience, sensitivity class, allowed_uses[]; purpose-specific retrieval (meeting prep must not return rep-performance analytics); rep-visible memory shows source/date/confidence/correction controls; rep-invisible memory prohibited from scoring/disciplining/ranking/coaching unless explicitly disclosed, authorized, proportionate, employment-law-governed — customer-helpful recall and employee monitoring separated technically, not by policy text; retrieval/export audit logs themselves access-restricted. Prospect side: jurisdiction-aware notice/consent (one-party federal baseline, multiple all-party states), consent records separated by lawful basis — never inferred across the three. Source boundaries at ingestion: personal email, private-calendar items, internal strategy threads, legal/privileged material excluded or quarantined BEFORE ingestion — never copied whole into persistent memory then filtered; internal-only threads in separately permissioned stores. Identity-linking: canonical ID namespaces; link only via authoritative CRM ID or deterministic account+deal+participant match; personal emails never joined to business contacts by calendar-invite coincidence; ambiguity as explicit state, not a prompt to guess. CompetitiveNote discipline: source_kind (customer_direct/rep_observation/public_source/hearsay/model_inference), confidence, review_after, supersession links; hearsay and model inference stay out of general battlecards unreviewed; single-deal observations never auto-promote to market facts. Evidence status (explicit): persistent-memory causal evidence "very limited"; Gong/Clari figures vendor-published or vendor-commissioned; the 14% Brynjolfsson figure is support-task evidence and must not be used as a sales-memory estimate; no verified regulatory action specifically targets sales-agent memory.

### 256. Support-agent memory measurements: grounding ablations are the only controlled win; pass⁸ is the honest metric (Grok, R43) — HIGH
Klarna (company+press): 2.3M chats (⅔ of volume, ~700 FTE-equiv), 11→<2 min (−82%), repeat inquiries −25%, $40M projected — then the 2025 reversal: rehiring humans as complex cases piled up (cautionary intent-mix case; escalation quality on the complex tail decides deployment survival). Intercom Fin: 67–76% claimed vs 42–50% third-party audit; Zendesk 20–40% typical / 60–80% optimized. Independent benchmarks: Outlearn 45.9% auto-resolved (29,003 conversations), 5.7% handoff; Comm100 44.8% resolved of handled (220M chats, sector spread 97.7%→38.1%). The only controlled memory-relevant ablations: knowledge grounding — context-vs-no-context 93.95% vs 7.31% accuracy, hallucinations 2.04% vs 55.35%; RAG + hallucination detector 97%→12.1% hallucination; user-profile ablation (arXiv 2510.07925): removing profile −5.6 to −7% retrieval accuracy; LD-Agent event memory = biggest gain over session-only baseline. τ-bench: gpt-4o 61.2% τ-retail pass¹, pass⁸ <25%; hyper-τ-bench 2026 best auto config 23.9% vs 82.2% engineer+model. AHT/cost: Metrigy −27% AHT with agent assist; hybrid blended cost −71% vs all-human at 22% escalation; escalation-rate deltas thinly reported (−15% aggregator claim, weak). Central gap: NO controlled memory-vs-no-memory ablation exists — all resolution/CSAT/conversion numbers are assistant-level or deployment-level. Phase-3 implications: measure resolution like Outlearn (denominator + silence + reopen rates), use pass^k as headline reliability metric, run the missing support memory-on/off ablation as a publication opportunity.

### 257. Shopping-agent memory measurements: no memory attribution anywhere; product-data is the bottleneck (Grok, R43) — MEDIUM
Rufus (Sensor Tower + Amazon): >40% vs ~20% conversion (2×), 60% more likely to purchase, $12B incremental annualized sales, 300M users — BUT account memory shipped Nov 2025 with ZERO disclosed deltas; no memory attribution anywhere in the figures. Walmart Sparky: AOV +35% for users (vendor-claimed). Sephora: 11% conversion on advice-seekers, AOV +25%. AgentShoppable (independent, 1,102 stores): 93% of mid-size / 81% of brands reach checkout with real cart; median 79% tasks — but only 17–21% expose structured product data, 0% publish barcodes: product-knowledge memory is the bottleneck, cart state isn't. CAVEAT (CMU+Microsoft, Sep 2026): user-optimal purchase 78.6%→17.3% under platform steering; harness +55% (v1) — directly memory-relevant failure taxonomy: separate immutable user-intent memory from steerable environment context. Fit-memory return claims (18–36%) are market-research vendor-tier only — flagged weakest. Scope note: R41 covered recommender-ranking memory; this is the agentic shopping-assistant angle (cart/session memory, purchase-history and size-fit memory, wishlist, cross-session preference) — and no controlled memory-on/off ablation exists in this domain either, a genuine Phase-3 publication opportunity. Vendor headlines inflate vs independent audits; "contained" vs "verified" resolution relabeling is common.

### 258. Support-memory ops: four-chokepoint redaction, four-tier deletion, drift-paged QA ladder (Fo, R43) — MEDIUM
Redaction must run at four chokepoints — input, retrieved chunks (commonly carry MORE PII than the prompt), model output, pre-persistence — with typed tags (<POLICY_REDACTED:EMAIL> style) and a per-redaction audit entry; Presidio carries Microsoft's own no-full-recall warning, so sampling-based leakage checks of summaries are mandatory, and single-point masking is a decoy (PII traverses nine systems in a voice stack alone). Deletion must propagate across source/embedding/analytics stores or the vector embedding becomes the leak (Garante-precedent failure: "we can't actually delete this" is itself a GDPR failure); mechanics: tag every memory with originating user ID at creation, sweep by key on erasure, emit deletion receipt; vector stores cannot prove erasure, forcing a design choice between inspectable memory and vector memory with a compensating deletion log. GDPR-delete-vs-EU-AI-Act-keep resolves into four tiers: ephemeral session context (auto-expire), erasable extracted facts, pseudonymized retained decision records (up to ~10y), model-influence records — treating them as one thing manufactures the conflict. Stale-policy prevention: every indexed passage carries source ID + last_verified + verified_by; uncertified passages unavailable to production agents (context validation BEFORE output validation). Detection: continuous 10%-of-live-traffic sampling with drift paging (a real case caught a 98%→81% drop in 90 minutes); low-scoring sessions promoted into the golden set as new edge cases. Gating: shadow mode → approval mode → limited autonomy per intent, rollback scoped to the affected intent; worst agentic failure is a wrong ACTION in the system of record (blast radius: accounts/payments/downstream; remediation: reverse + notify + compensate). Handoff protocol: durable structured case written BEFORE transfer announced — intent, status, permitted customer details, what happened (checks/steps/failures), risk flags, escalation reason, explicit uncertainty field, links to backing records; transcript as evidence; channel continuity preserved; metrics: customer repetition rate and first-human-action accuracy. Merged-identities/PII-in-summary leaks share one root: loose identity linkage + summaries reconstituting PII — counter with identity resolution against a single verified identifier, typed redaction tags surviving into summaries, and an identity-boundary test set (same-surname households, shared devices, reused phone numbers). Research-derived, first-pass topic; EU-jurisdiction regulatory cites; no controlled studies.

### 259. Insurance-claims agent memory ops: human-review gate, evidence-grade files, fraud-signal quarantine (Fo, R43) — MEDIUM
No consequential claim decision may issue from AI alone — the human-review gate is the regulatory floor: Texas TDI B-0003-26 (June 2026) expects a person to review and agree with any consequential AI-supported decision before action, systems open to inspection with evidence of verification against inaccurate/arbitrary/discriminatory outcomes; Florida SB 202 would bar AI-only denials outright, require naming the responsible professional, and mandate written confirmation to the policyholder (proposed, not confirmed enacted). Decision-class gate: AI may draft/triage/summarize/recommend; any memory write that constitutes a coverage determination, denial, or settlement commitment must carry a named human approver and timestamp; "the AI made a mistake" is no defense against bad-faith claims in 2026 courts. Claim memory must be evidence-grade: one repository per claim, SHA-256 hash at intake, append-only chain of custody (every view/edit/share/download logged with attribution), corrections as linked supplemental documents never silent overwrites (NY Reg 152 mandates tamper safeguards), PII/PHI redaction with auditable change records, role-based access. FNOL-to-settlement is an explicit human-checkpointed state machine; straight-through processing is legitimate only inside bounded non-consequential classes (36h vs 10 days, 31% AI-driven volume — vendor/press directional); mis-categorized FNOL flowing straight through into a wrong determination at speed is the failure mode. Fraud-adjacent signals persist as QUARANTINED signals, never adjudicated facts: scores/referrals with expiry plus a human-verified outcome field; network/link assertions require verified entity resolution before touching the file (merged-identity has defamation-level consequences); "AI screens cases. Investigators close them." Audit chain: input data → model version → score → referral → human action → final outcome. Assessment verification states: model-only / human-confirmed / disputed — human verification before an AI-assessed damage figure becomes the claim-file value; auto-proceed below threshold only inside the STP boundary. Regulatory retention 3–7 years (NY 6y post-closure, CA 5y from injury, AZ 3y rolling; litigation holds override all) vs erasable interaction-memory tier (chat transcripts, agent summaries, embeddings) — the spec must name which tier each store belongs to. Dispute/appeal memory and privileged material (coverage-counsel opinions, SIU strategy notes) need separate access-restricted namespaces. Stale claim status: every status memory carries as_of + source (the claims system, not agent inference). New layer: Meta's Muse Wonder (Oct 15, 2026) consumer-side agent memory on denied claims — the carrier's file is no longer the only record; carrier appeal-handling must link each appeal to its prior determination and its named human decision-maker. Research-derived, first-pass topic; regulatory cites jurisdiction-scoped and status-sensitive; vendor performance figures directional.

### 260. Journalism agent memory: said/verified/publishable tripartition, quote integrity, immutable StoryEvents (ChatGPT, R44) — HIGH
Newsroom memory is an evidence-management system: reported_assertion ("a source said X") must never be silently upgraded to verified_fact ("X is true"). Story state = immutable StoryEvents with distinct occurred_at/recorded_at; summaries are regenerable, never authoritative. Quote integrity is the tightest control: a quote is retrievable only with exact text + specific attribution + verification state, byte-for-byte checked against the source record — never quote marks around a paraphrase (directly addresses the deployed El Comercio failure where agents "filled information gaps with arbitrary data"). Three-store separation (BeatKnowledge / story working memory / unverified assertions) with promotion requiring a logged verification event — never "because the claim appears repeatedly." Pre-publication gate ladder: claim-to-source linkage → quote-against-source verification (strictest rung; AI quotes need tape/transcript confirmation) → sensitivity screening → named human sign-off ("no fully automated publishing"; Redazione Zero AI verifiers that block publication are the reference). This is the newsroom instantiation of the program's "assert-not-truth" signature (R43 sales, R44 newsroom): the controller must preserve the said/verified distinction at the schema level. Honest baseline: NO controlled study isolates memory as a causal intervention for reporting accuracy or speed — only deployment artifacts (Story Object Model open standard, BR "Second Opinion" summarize-then-verify QC, NYT News Agent, RuntimeWire's attribution-gated publishing); both consultations supplied preregistered memory-on/off test designs instead.

### 261. Newsroom source protection: three-layer memory design + closed-loop correction propagation (ChatGPT + Fo, R44) — HIGH
General-purpose story memory must never persist a confidential source's identity; identity mapping lives in a separate, distinctly-authorized system, and the controller must not join it to beat/location/schedule metadata. De-anonymization-by-linkage test: combination queries from unauthorized roles must return neither identity nor identifying inference. ChatGPT's explicit caveat: "No technical design can guarantee anonymity if authorized humans or external information can reconstruct it." Fo's ops layer: redaction-before-AI-ingest (never paste identifiers into public tools), access-tiered identity (anonymized source handles in working memory; identity→handle mapping in a separate legal-controlled vault), self-hosted/on-prem storage. Legal anchor: no US federal shield law (PRESS Act died in the Senate Dec 2024; Massachusetts passed one July 2026) — memory stores holding identities are discoverable. Correction propagation must be closed-loop across derived artifacts INCLUDING the memory index (canonical URL, dateModified, newsletter/social/feed excerpts, retrieval-chunk and summary sweeps) — otherwise the next AI draft re-derives the corrected fact; Veritate.ro's 116-entry public corrections register is the reference. Embargo handling = time-locked access control with per-access audit logs; failure mode is embargo leak through summarization into shared memory — mitigate with lift-time gating of retrieval. Research-derived (Fo), first-pass topic; regulatory patchwork US/EU/India — not legal advice.

### 262. Recruiting agent memory: protected-attribute exclusion as a five-part testable gate (ChatGPT, R44) — HIGH
Pattern-learning vs discrimination boundary = (1) job-related, (2) consistently measured, (3) validated for role/use, (4) adverse-impact reviewed, (5) approved — with a written validation record and predeclared disparity thresholds. "Predicted success among previous hires" is explicitly INSUFFICIENT — historical labels encode unequal opportunity; memory-as-similarity-retrieval is a discrimination vector, testable via counterfactual probes holding qualifications constant. Decision provenance: HiringDecision must cite source evidence IDs and a criteria version, never an AI summary alone; final hire/reject requires recorded human approval and candidate-specific evidence review — "a system that merely asks a human to rubber-stamp an opaque score does not satisfy this requirement." Interviewer feedback as attributed opinion (source_type: interviewer_opinion, conflicts explicit, never averaged into "the team thinks"); purpose-specific consent (talent pool ≠ active application); deletion propagating across stores, embeddings, caches, replicas, processors with a verifiable completion record; stale assessments blocked from scoring until refreshed. Evidence status: NO controlled evidence candidate memory improves hiring quality or time-to-hire without degrading fairness — vendor claims are marketing; the cautionary record is Amazon 2018 (abandoned tool), EEOC 2023 guidance, NYC Local Law 144.

### 263. Hiring-memory ops: human gates as configuration, two-tier retention, per-stage bias instrumentation (Fo, R44) — MEDIUM
Advisory-only scoring + named reviewer on borderlines + one record linking score→threshold→decision; rejection requires a human-confirmed reason field blocking the stage change; overrides recorded (EU AI Act Art. 14; Colorado appeal right). Two-tier retention: candidate PII (6–12 months unsuccessful, consent-gated pools, Illinois 30-day video deletion) separated from retained pseudonymized decision records (3–5 years, structured audit logs: inputs, features, scores+confidence, versions, overrides) — the tiered-retention pattern now holds in support (R43), insurance (R43), and hiring. Bias instrumentation per-stage, per-subgroup: adverse impact shows at screening and washes out by offer — hire-rate-only review misses it; evidence from Eightfold's 2026 BABL AI audit (23.8M candidates) vs Wilson & Caliskan name-bias (85.1% vs 8.6%) and filter-defaults bias before any model. No-inferred-attributes rule: forbid storing/persisting inferred protected attributes; name/photo blinding at screening. Provenance protocol: immutable interviewer notes (author/timestamp/role/anchors), AI summaries labeled provisional, verbatim evidence quote per score. Caveat: several failure modes (de-anonymization-through-memory-linkage, stale-assessment, merged-identity) are preventive-practice derivations, not documented incidents. Research-derived, first-pass topic.

### 264. Travel-agent memory measurements: benchmark floor near zero; field memory failures documented (Grok, R44) — MEDIUM
Peer floor: TravelPlanner (arXiv 2402.01622) — GPT-4-Turbo 0.6% final pass rate, all others 0%; >30-point gap between tool-use vs pre-provided-info modes; authors explicitly suggest better memory. TravelBench (Dec 2025) is the first benchmark scoring implicit-preference discovery across turns — the closest thing to a memory-centric instrument in the domain. Field memory failure: Propellic/Touchstone behavioral study (Aug 2026) — 3 in 4 booking handoffs lost dates and guest counts; trust stayed (4.1/5 recommendation), blame landed on the merchant. Deployments: 82–89% completion top-tier (Google AI Mode 89% hotel-only, Amadeus 87% mixed — weak press sourcing); MIT Sloan early 2026: 76% correct preference interpretation, ancillaries misread; Reservations.ai voice booking conversion 1–2%→14–16% (human parity, vendor-claimed); Mindtrip traveler-profile memory 3× trip-creation (vendor-claimed beta). Rebooking: 73% first-attempt accuracy vs 91% human (weak sourcing); AI surfaces alternatives in 96% of ferry cases but only 38% actionable. Central gap: NO controlled memory-on/off ablation on booking/completion/conversion exists. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN, OpenRouter 402); several SEO-grade sources directional only.

### 265. Supply-chain agent memory measurements: the one real ablation; memory-management beats full history (Grok, R44) — HIGH
AIM-RM (arXiv 2503.18201) is the ONE peer paper with an explicit memory-on/off ablation in multi-echelon inventory (vector-DB episodic memory, K=6 retrieval, with/without RL-log init) — headline deltas not extractable from review text; FLAGGED as the round-45 priority pull for direct paper extraction. Dynamics 365 F&O agent study (arXiv 2606.10209): 8%→91.6% task completion via pruning + summarization — memory MANAGEMENT regime dominates, beating full history by 20 points. Risk-adjusted AI ordering cut stockouts −71.91% vs fixed reorder (Holm-significant) while XGBoost beat a 7-day moving average by only 2.74% MAE — the gain is policy/risk-framing, not forecast memory. Phase-3 measurement rule: hold policy constant when measuring memory, else policy gains get misattributed. Hackett AI World Class benchmarks (12 Oct 2026, modeled): forecast error −52%, carrying cost −41%, expedited orders −59%. BCG: 88% fail; recommendation acceptance 70–85% as the trust proxy in the performing band — treat acceptance rate as the memory-trust metric. Named deployments: automotive OTD 82%→94% (5 agents, 18 mo); GEP pharma −40% obsolete inventory; GAINS $21M inventory reduction, −18% lost sales, >900% ROI; Kenco Agent K 500 labor-hours/mo at 99.96% accuracy. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); deployment deltas confound memory with integration/model/policy depth; "NexusLogistics swarm" pseudonymized marketing excluded from evidence.

### 266. AIM-RM memory-on/off ablation: 40% optimality-gap closed; memory substitutes for reasoning (Grok, R45) — HIGH
CORRECTION: R44 cited arXiv 2503.18201 for AIM-RM — that ID is wrong (it resolves to "Iterative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning", a different paper). The actual AIM-RM paper is arXiv 2602.05524 (Yoshizato et al., AAMAS 2026), read in full with the ablation table extracted directly. Multi-echelon inventory, vector-DB episodic memory (K=6, τ=2), o4-mini, 5 scenarios × 5 episodes, metric = relative optimality gap (lower = better), medium reasoning: no-memory InvAgent 152.55 → 91.27 with IPPO-RL-seeded episodic memory = −61.28 points, ≈40% gap closed, ranked first in all 5 scenarios. Memory-content ablation: empty memory 138.59 → RL-seeded 91.27 (≈34% further) — content quality matters, not just presence. Memory↔reasoning substitution: at high reasoning the memory advantage vanishes (150.74 vs 134.53, memory-less slightly wins); in the static Constant-Uniform scenario memory-off hits optimal (0.00–3.33) while memory agents lag (60–69). Two Phase-3 rules: (1) memory substitutes for reasoning effort — evaluate memory at matched reasoning budgets, not as a free addition; (2) memory needs a relevance gate (τ=2 precedent) — irrelevant memory actively hurts in static regimes. This is the pipeline's cleanest memory-on/off ablation number. Do not propagate the 2503.18201 ID.

### 267. Construction agent memory: index over authoritative records, current-issue check, safety hard boundaries (ChatGPT, R45) — HIGH
Memory must be an INDEX over authoritative records, never a replacement — enforced by a "current-issue check" gate: no drawing-dependent action without verified CDE status, applicability, approval, supersession chain, and content hash (ISO 19650 states; LOD 100–500 is not permission to construct); blocks when the check fails or conflicts. As-built discrepancy rules: measured-vs-planned against CONTRACT tolerances only, superintendent/surveyor/design-professional confirmation tiers, never-convert-a-field-observation-into-an-approved-design-change; disputed subcontractor memory keeps claims attributed and contested-flagged, never laundered into scores; equipment memory carries source+freshness, stale telemetry expired. Safety-incident memory hard boundaries: never downgrade severity, never decide legal recordability, never suppress notifications; OSHA 8hr (fatality)/24hr (hospitalization/amputation/eye-loss) triggers human escalation, not autonomous legal conclusions; Procore/Autodesk workflows are not statutory registers. Converges with R42's verification-on-retrieval and R43's authoritative-source precedence: the controller never presents memory as authoritative state — it presents the check that the authoritative record is current. Evidence status: NO published causal evidence that agent memory improves rework, schedule, or TRIR/DART (FMI/McKinsey are surveys, not memory trials); prescribed Phase-3 test is prospective measurement vs documented baseline controlling for size, delivery method, trade mix, reporting practices. Market color: Buildots $130M round (Sept 2026, 100+ large firms) is the closest production as-built memory, claims unverified; Procore 20 Digital Coworkers; vendor 12–18% schedule-overrun reductions are marketing, not evidence.

### 268. Fitness-coaching agent memory: injury as first-class safety state; fitness/medical line is regulatory (ChatGPT, R45) — MEDIUM
Injury/contraindication memory as first-class safety state: SafetyRecord/Restriction schemas; never silently expire; "resolved" ≠ clearance; clearance_required=true gates return-to-training; restrictions checked TWICE per response (before exercise selection AND before generation); pain reports preserved even if transient — "do not tell users to push through pain." The fitness-vs-medical line is regulatory, not taste: GDPR Art 9 (health = special category), FDA general-wellness vs device-intended-use, FTC substantiation — persist authorized goals/plans/volunteered injury history only; diagnoses/prescriptions/clinician notes highly restricted, never used for unrelated personalization; red flags (chest pain, syncope, severe dyspnea) → stop coaching, urgent-care guidance; "a disclaimer does not make an otherwise medical-device function compliant." Evidence status: NO robust trial isolates persistent fitness-agent memory as a causal intervention for adherence/outcomes — structural confound (engaged users log more AND do better; STEP 4 tested behavioral intervention, not memory); prescribed test: same coach with vs without persistent memory, pre-registered adherence + safety + outcomes, attrition analyzed. User-inspectable/editable memory is already shippable: WHOOP's "my memory" feature (Oct 12, 2026) lets members see/edit everything the AI knows, "PII never touches the model" as intentional friction. Motivational memory bans shame/guilt/coercive streak-loss; preferences revisable. Published failure rates for memory-type failures in commercial fitness agents not well established.

### 269. Agriculture agent memory: chemical records as regulatory infrastructure; disease diagnoses need a human gate (Grok + Fo, R45) — MEDIUM
FIFRA/WPS schema is DICTATED: product, EPA registration number, active ingredients, location, area, crop, date/time, amount, method, applicator + certification — recorded within 2 working days, retained 2 years, available to regulators and workers; the ABSENCE of records IS the violation. Design lever: machine-generated records (e.g., Greeneye's dual-tank per-pass logs) preferred over manual recall; restricted-use products license-gated. Disease-diagnosis gate: Cornell 2024 trial found 22–39% false-positive rates on biotic disease diagnoses; worst tools gave a single "most likely" diagnosis with no confidence — design: candidates with probabilities + evidence images, "unverified" default, promotion only by agronomist/lab confirmation, named human confirmation before chemical actions. Field identity must be polygon-anchored, not name-anchored: multi-vendor machinery histories "require extra mapping and governance discipline" — spatial-overlap identity-resolution gate on imports; unresolvable records quarantine, never merge. Measurements: FarmerChat 2.0 (Digital Green) — 10L+ users, 60% act on advice (60 Decibels), 91% confidence, cost ₹3,300→₹33/farmer/yr, new "evolving farmer profile" memory layer (crop/season/past-questions); Syngenta Cropwise Explorer — season-to-season field-history + NDVI anomaly memory, 2M farmers on GenAI chatbot (95% accuracy vendor-claimed). AgriEval peer floor: LLMs average 41.27% on expert ag questions. LSTM irrigation: −28.57% water / −74.74% motor energy (Sci Reports 2026). Soil/weather provenance gated prescriptions (sample-date, method, resolution; recency checks; flags instead of silent use of stale inputs); season-indexed archival with retrieval decay; outbreak history as highest-value carry-forward. No published memory-on/off ablation exists for agriculture agents specifically. Research-derived (Fo), first-pass topic; regulatory references US-centric (FIFRA/WPS/40 CFR Part 170).

### 270. Grid agent memory: 1°F=$100k/h monetization metric; memory is architectural, not ablated (Grok, R45) — MEDIUM
Santee Cooper: 1°F forecast error = $100,000/hour — Phase-3's monetization metric for forecast memory. Grid-Mind (peer): persistent cross-session memory + lesson loop — 84.0% tool-selection accuracy, 100% parsing, self-correction 49/56 (mean 89.29) — the best memory-architecture precedent in grid agents, but with NO off-condition. LLM-Mediated Demand Response (peer, simulation): structured directives 33.3% curtailment cooperation vs 28.0% no-intervention; exploitation memory in the agent design. LEMAD (peer, real SGCC data): F1 88.78%, +10.3% over traditional. Outage: EGM fault location (26 blind NLR scenarios) 3–5 hr → ~1 hr; SAIDI −45–60% (market report, vendor-grade). NextEra Grid Composer (press): half-trillion data points/day, $20M+ customer savings 2026. Caveat: no memory-on/off ablation exists for grid agents specifically; memory attribution absent across field deployments; vendor/PR numbers dominate. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic.

### 271. Construction/agriculture memory ops: OSHA-timeline incident propagation, two-reviewer gate, polygon-anchored identity (Fo, R45) — MEDIUM
Construction: drawing-revision sync is a status-gated memory problem — 2026 practice is AI cross-referencing document sets and flagging anything not the latest "Issued for Construction" revision; superseded P&IDs cause rework and safety hazards (Pathnovo's "cutting into the wrong pipeline"); as-built comparisons against outdated revisions are "technically accurate but operationally irrelevant." Safety-incident propagation runs on OSHA timelines: mobile capture → AI recordability classification under OSHA 1904 → investigation routing → corrective-action tracking through closeout → auto-populated 300/300A/301 forms and ITA submission; the anti-failure is the UNPROPAGATED incident (notebook/chat incidents that never reach the log), with >$165K fines per willful/repeat violation; corrective-action tracking is the close-the-loop guarantee. Two-reviewer gate for AI on site: treat AI as a proposal generator, acceptance threshold is reproducibility by two competent reviewers from controlled inputs, with model-version + source-revision + assumptions + independent-check traceability — adopted BEFORE AI touches safety decisions. Change-order audit trails live in the CDE (8–14% of project cost at stake); disputed entries preserved with dispute history, never silently merged. Agriculture: domain-validation gate for agronomic recommendations (see 269); field identity polygon-anchored (see 269); event-sourced equipment memory (telemetry + defect events asset-keyed into work orders, calibration records preserved); season-indexed archival with retrieval decay. New program pattern: regulatory-dictated memory schemas (FIFRA/WPS chemical records, OSHA 1904 incident classification + 8/24hr reporting, FDA wellness-vs-device, GDPR Art 9 health data) — in physical-world domains the schema is law, not recommendation; Phase-3 should catalog these as constraints, not design choices. Research-derived, first-pass topic; sources document 2026 operations and regulatory requirements, not agent-memory systems per se — memory-ops reading is extrapolation, labeled; equipment-state drift had no construction-specific documented failure — flagged for a later targeted pass.

### 272. Real-estate agent memory: fair-housing hard boundary, preference-loop risk, listing freshness gate (ChatGPT, R46) — HIGH
Fair housing is the hard boundary: no collecting/inferring/using protected traits (or proxies) to rank, match, or steer — but the critical memory-specific risk is the PREFERENCE-LEARNING LOOP itself: historical clicks/transactions/notes encode bias, so recommendations must be tested across groups. Law anchors: FHA protected classes, Inclusive Communities (2015) disparate impact, HUD 2023 AI guidance; nuance: the law is not a universal never-store rule (accommodation exception exists). Strict liability on advertising language (intent doesn't matter): AI's likely-wording defaults ("perfect for young families," "safe neighborhood") are exactly what violates 42 U.S.C. 3604(c); memory hazard = reusable listing libraries laundering biased language — design: scrubbed/verified flag, banned-phrase audit on every write, human review before syndication. Listing memory as append-only event stream (Property/ListingEvent/PriceEvent with correction lineage) plus a FRESHNESS GATE: no "available"/showing/price action without a fresh authoritative check and shown "as of" time — the freshness-gate pattern now spans dev repos (R42), construction (R45), real estate, support policy (R43), finance as_of facts (R42). Negotiation memory with party-isolated confidentiality (walk-away thresholds in client-only workspaces, never fabricated competing offers, audience labels); transaction memory as versioned event stream with layered deadline controls (reminder ≠ contractual notice); preference memory separating stated/observed/inferred, never converting geography into demographic labels. Ops layer (Fo): ComplianceAI pre-closing gate — file cannot advance to closing week with open items; full audit-trail taxonomy (document-review history, key-date change history with before/after, eSignature certs, commission/disbursement ledger — all append-only, named actors, party attribution); NAR-settlement tracking (pre-tour buyer agreements, per-transaction compensation disclosures, split-rule versioning); TC morning-triage as the deadline-ops model (contract-derived dates, daily at-risk queue, no "met" status without evidence); AI extraction is candidate-tier until human-verified. Evidence status: NO causal evidence persistent agent memory improves match quality, wasted showings, time-to-close, or satisfaction — corroborated by NAR 2025 data: 41% of REALTORS use AI, only 17% report significant positive business effect, ~half no noticeable difference. Research-derived (Fo), first-pass topic; regulatory references US-centric.

### 273. Marketing-campaign agent memory: no causal evidence (third straight verdict); brand memory as permissioned evidence (ChatGPT, R46) — MEDIUM
No established causal evidence that persistent agent memory improves ROAS, CTR, conversions, or creative quality — third consecutive no-evidence verdict (R44 recruiting, R45 construction, now marketing); the no-causal-evidence streak now spans 8+ verticals (support, sales, shopping, journalism, recruiting, travel, construction, fitness, real estate, marketing), with AIM-RM (R45) the sole clean memory-on/off ablation in the entire corpus — the pipeline's honest ledger is a publishable meta-finding. Vendor claims bundle targeting/bidding/automation and never isolate memory; Lewis & Rao (2015) is methodological evidence that ad-effect measurement is hard, not memory evidence; public "numbers" are time-savings (Upgrowth 8–10h/mo), never memory-attributed lift. Brand memory as versioned, permissioned evidence: immutable guideline versions, new creative resolves against the currently-approved version, human approval for new/altered claims, fail closed — converges with the SalStack video's Claims.csv-evidence-check pattern and Simplified's approval queue. Consent-withdrawal propagation with tested SLOs (e.g., 24h suppression) through DERIVED individual records; creative-asset publish-time rights checks ("prior successful use is not evidence of current authorization"); the personalization-vs-manipulation line sits at exploiting predicted weakness (FTC §5, DSA profiling limits). First-pass topic; public discourse is vendor product launches (DaVinci Brand Agent Oct 6 2026, Meta brand memory Cannes Lions 2026, Klaviyo Composer) and trade content — not memory architecture or evidence.

### 274. Manufacturing agent memory measurements: P&L evidence without memory isolation (Grok, R46) — MEDIUM
Industry band (press-reported, McKinsey 2025): 30–50% unplanned-downtime reduction, 20–40% equipment-life extension, 300–500% ROI with 6–18-month payback — but memory is NEVER isolated from the sensor-model pipeline. Unilever Indaiatuba (named company, press-reported): $2.3M annual savings, 45% maintenance-cost reduction, $1.2M investment recovered in <7 months. GE Aerospace: 60% earlier preventive-maintenance lead time, false alerts halved. Siemens Senseye Maintenance Copilot (closest to a production memory agent — error-code→natural language via operational history): 25% average reduction in reactive maintenance time (vendor-claimed). Schneider Electric + Microsoft agentic manufacturing: up to 50% time savings on control config/docs, line changes weeks→hours (vendor-claimed). Peer papers: 91% fault-diagnosis accuracy (arXiv 2410.03223); MindRAG (agent + multimodal RAG over CM database, qualitative decision-support results); LLM-R/AMMA (>90% anomaly detection, F1 >0.88, simulated datasets). Core caveat: NO published memory-on/off ablation exists anywhere — every delta is system-level. Counterweight: MIT NANDA found 95% of GenAI pilots had no measurable P&L impact. Transferable Phase-3 metrics: false-alarm rate and warning-lead-time as memory-quality metrics; MindRAG's retrieval-isolation trick. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic.

### 275. Restaurant/hospitality agent memory: memory failure is the measured cost; memory gain is the missing experiment (Grok, R46) — MEDIUM
Delight.ai 2026 Delight AI Index (n=1,000 US, independent): 70% "more delighted" if AI remembered prior interactions — memory outranks empathy. Twilio 2026 Customer Insights (n=7,652 consumers + 660 leaders, 18 markets, independent): 70% abandoned AI mid-interaction over memory failure; 5% ended the brand relationship; 84% of brands believe AI recognizes customers vs 70% of consumers forced to start from scratch. Slang.ai Superhost (Oct 2026, vendor-claimed): first production restaurant agent with explicit guest memory (prior conversations, preferences, visit history, allergies, birthdays) — 50% more phone reservations captured, 96% caller satisfaction. Upsell AOV tension: vendors claim 15–30% (SoundHound $2–5/order); the ONLY large-sample measured figure is Hi Auto's 1.5% across ~1,000 stores — flagged for Phase-3 adjudication. Labor/revenue: SevenRooms/Casper 3,800+ calls, $28K booked revenue/month; Loman +22% phone revenue, −17% labor (vendor-claimed). Core caveat: the corpus measures reservation CAPTURE (answering missed calls) far more than preference MEMORY; surveys quantify the cost of memory failure, not the gain from memory success — the with-memory/on-off ablation is the missing experiment. Review/sentiment memory: no 2025–2026 published measurements found at all. Transferable: identity-resolution as a first-class metric (6–16% duplicate guest profiles); the Twilio survey as a ready "memory-off" field baseline for hospitality. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic.

### 276. Factory/equipment-memory ops: agent proposes, never auto-dispatches; calibration is the "stale data kills" failure (Fo, R46) — MEDIUM
Augury's Reliability Agent is the documented 2026 pattern for the human-validation gate: CAT III/IV vibration analysts validate AI findings BEFORE they reach the maintenance team; pre-filled work orders sit "ready for your review before anything enters the queue" — agent may propose, never auto-dispatches. Calibration memory: out-of-cal instruments poison every measurement they touch — controls are NIST-traceability chains, recall scheduling with advance notifications, and reverse traceability (failed as-found check → every affected job immediately identifiable); out-of-cal status must QUARANTINE the asset, not just annotate it. Shift handoff loses ~50% accuracy per verbal hop — fix is a signed digital handoff contract (open work orders, active lockouts, consumed parts, failure codes, SOP checkpoint), QR-code asset scan inheriting context. Shadow maintenance (undocumented operator tweaks destroying the machine baseline) → fuse telemetry baselines against the recorded log; raise "unlogged intervention" exceptions. Spare-parts memory must be usage-linked (60% of MTTR is waiting for parts; consumption atomic with work-order closeout; reorder from observed consumption × lead time). LOTO register is the privileged memory class — real-time, never cached, human physical "try out" cannot be waived. Caveat: PM-window gate practice is thin in the literature — flagged for a targeted pass. Research-derived, first-pass topic; sources are vendor/practitioner/association/regulator operations docs, not agent-memory systems — memory-ops reading is extrapolation, labeled; regulatory references US-centric (OSHA 1910.147, NIST, ISO 17025).
