### 278. Government-service agent memory: GOV.UK session-only baseline, wrongful-denial stack, three-tier minimization (ChatGPT + Grok, R47) — MEDIUM
The honest center, converged across three analyses: the memory layer is mostly ABSENT BY DESIGN in government deployments (privacy/retention), not measured — and the best-measured deployment, GOV.UK Chat (accuracy 76%→90% across 26,000 questions, 10K+ users, 508/508 jailbreaks blocked), is a stateless RAG tool whose gains come from retrieval grounding, not memory; it MUST NOT be cited as memory evidence. Other deployments (SSA: 40% faster benefit applications; Ask Jamie Singapore: call-centre −50%; Virginia regulatory pilot: permit times −80%; Army procurement: $37M/year + 687K hours) are system-level, never memory-isolated. Counter-signal: Singapore digital score +4.7% but citizen experience −5.8% (faster ≠ more satisfying). Phase-3 publication opportunity: use GOV.UK Chat's session-only baseline for the field's first real memory-on/off study on benefits/permit assistants. Wrongful-denial control stack: memory can never alone establish ineligibility; freshness gates by fact type (re-verify income at recertification); system-of-record wins conflicts; merged-identity blocking; adverse actions need substantive human review. Anchors: SNAP (7 C.F.R. §§ 273.2(f), 273.12), Medicaid (42 C.F.R. §§ 435.945–435.956), Goldberg v. Kelly, Mathews v. Eldridge, Privacy Act, Federal Records Act/NARA, FOIA. Three-tier data minimization (session-only / persistent-minimal / source-system-only) with a need-to-serve test; never store immigration status, diagnoses, precise income, or general family profiles in agent memory; language preference must never profile (literacy, dialect, immigration status). Language Access for All Act (H.R. 7223/S. 4985, in committee — not law): qualified-human review of AI-translated critical communications before public release; FOIA pattern: AI proposes, qualified FOIA professionals release. Genuine gaps: no 2026 source on citizen-data-minimization protocols for agent memory; merged citizen identities undocumented. Research-derived (Grok), first-pass topic.

### 279. Meaningful-human-review as legal standard; NARA AI-records retention; WISeR as the 2026 exemplar (Fo, R47) — HIGH
The WISeR Medicare case is the 2026 exemplar of the failure/gate pair: vendors paid a share of averted expenditures issued 20,000+ denials in 3 months; automation-bias research shows "human clinician reviews every denial" degrades to rubber-stamping; KFF 80.7% overturned-on-appeal vs 11.5% appealed. The emerging legal standard (Connecticut ban, Florida proposals) is MEANINGFUL human review — independent evaluation plus exercised override; rubber-stamping excluded. This joins Texas TDI (R43), Florida SB 202 (R43), and the construction two-reviewer gate (R45) as a program-level design constraint. NARA's 2026 AI-records guidance + Army CIO memo make retention an affirmative design requirement: prompts, outputs, recommendations, audit trails are federal records; AGENT SELF-PRUNING OUTSIDE THE FILE-PLAN SCHEDULE IS ITSELF A RECORDS-RETENTION VIOLATION. Research-derived, first-pass topic; sources are 2026 practice literature — memory-ops readings are labeled extrapolations; advocacy figures directional.

### 280. Translation memory: Language Twin is the only true memory-on/off ablation; COMET is blind to termbase failures (Grok, R47) — HIGH
Language Twin is the only true memory-on/off ablation in the domain: 5/5 blind preference (Fisher's p=0.008), terminology rating 4.38/5 vs 3.97/5, post-edit time 16.9s vs 19.1s per segment (~11.5% faster), −39.2% prompt tokens — joins AIM-RM (R45) as the corpus's only clean memory ablations. CHORUS (peer, arXiv 2602.19016): shared TM service with namespaced glossaries/style guides; 3 LLM backbones, 11 directions, WMT23/24 — BLEU up to +10.6, COMET up to +8.7 over single-agent; COMET +21.7% relative; distant pairs (JA/ZH/HE) >+20%; p<0.001 — but bundles memory with multi-agent architecture (only Language Twin isolates memory itself). MAATS (peer): multi-agent MQM found 41,547 issues vs 9,217 single-agent (~450%). Practitioner: glossary injection cut name inconsistencies ~15%→<2%; DeepL+memoQ team −30% post-editing workload. METRIC CAVEAT (Intento LQA): COMET scores termbase violations ABOVE compliant averages (0.944–0.971) — memory-free metrics are blind to the failures glossary memory prevents; Phase-3 must add termbase-compliance metrics alongside COMET. Phase-3: replicate Language Twin at scale; adopt CHORUS's namespaced TM schema (namespaces for glossaries/style guides). Post-editing lift can be negative depending on model/content (China benchmark: +30.6 on raw MT UGC, −3.7 on ChatGPT marketing). Intento 2025 (vendor): requirements-based customization → 5–10x fewer errors than baseline. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic; Language Twin is pilot-scale.

### 281. Accessibility agent memory: the autonomy metric trap; anti-paternalism line; consent architecture (ChatGPT, R47) — MEDIUM
The sharpest design insight of the round: for assistive agents, TASK COMPLETION CAN RISE WHILE INDEPENDENCE FALLS (the agent takes over) — evaluation must measure autonomy/control/confidence, not just speed. No strong causal evidence that persistent cross-session profile memory improves independence/task success over good first-run setup. Anti-paternalism line: memory may guide HOW assistance is offered, never WHAT THE USER MAY ATTEMPT — no refusing tasks based on inferred limitation, no auto-escalation to caregivers, explicit "do it myself / coach me" mode; "nothing about us without us" mapped to inspectable/editable/exportable/deletable profiles. Consent architecture: granular revocable permissions; functional preferences ("use high contrast") over diagnoses ("macular degeneration"); caregiver/shared-device separation; disability-fingerprint warning on portable profiles. Portability gap (established): no universal standard exists — WCAG is web content, W3C Personalization Semantics is adaptation semantics not a profile, AccessForAll is learning-context only; ChatGPT proposes a versioned export format (recommendation, not adoption). The YouTube query returned ZERO accessibility-specific memory content — a finding in itself about the discourse vacuum. Numbers cited (Be My Eyes 1.1M users/11.1M volunteers/100K daily interactions, Ray-Ban Meta Brera pilot) describe deployments, not memory-outcome studies. First-pass topic; legal anchors US-centric.

### 282. Inferred disability = undisclosed disclosure; accommodation portability gap (Fo, R47) — HIGH
arXiv 2609.22720 "When Disability Disclosure Travels" gives the sharpest failure mode: assistants infer disability from content/behavior, and an inferred attribute is A DISCLOSURE THE SENDER NEVER MADE — gate: surface inferences as disclosures with confirm/correct/discard before persistence; inferred attributes tagged and TTL'd. Regulatory pressure aligns: Gartner (inferences = dominant privacy-incident vector by 2029), GDPR/CCPA treating inferred health data as sensitive, Delaware's Jan-2027 explicit-consent rule for health inferences. Paternalistic override has a cheap gate: pre-delivery consistency check against stated constraints (the commonest failure was recommending something the user said they cannot do); AAC practice adds team-collaboration before significant changes to someone's assistive system. The portability gap: GPII + ISO/IEC 24751 PNP defined portable, private, user-controlled accommodation profiles a decade ago, but 2026 agents don't implement them; session-scoped widgets (accessiBe) are the concrete lost-preference failure. Urban Institute playbook (Aug 2026): "accessible audit trail" so non-experts can understand agent decisions — applied as append-only, user-inspectable accommodation-change events. Genuine gaps: no standardized 2026 consent protocol; assistive-device-state memory in agentic systems undocumented. Research-derived, first-pass topic; sources are 2026 practice literature — memory-ops readings are labeled extrapolations.

### 283. Inferred-attribute discipline as a program pattern (R47 synthesis) — MEDIUM
R47 completes a four-domain pattern for inferred sensitive attributes: disability inferences (R47, 282) — surface as disclosures, confirm/correct/discard, tag + TTL; protected attributes in hiring (R44) — five-part testable gate, memory-as-similarity-retrieval as discrimination vector; protected traits in real estate (R46) — banned-phrase audits, no proxying, test recommendations across groups; sentiment as expiring observation (R43) — never a durable trait. The program pattern: NEVER PERSIST INFERRED SENSITIVE ATTRIBUTES AS DURABLE TRAITS; the permitted forms are surfaced-with-consent, tagged-and-TTLed, expiring-observation, or gated-by-validation-record. Regulatory pressure is converging (GDPR/CCPA sensitive-data treatment of inferences, Delaware Jan-2027 explicit-consent rule for health inferences, Gartner's 2029 prediction) — Phase-3 should treat inferred-attribute discipline as a controller-level invariant, not a per-domain policy.

### 284. Elder-care agent memory: senior is the principal; graduated escalation; no causal memory evidence (ChatGPT, R48) — MEDIUM
Family status alone confers no data access; purpose-separated consent (medication / safety / routine / caregiver sharing / escalation); never infer diagnoses (dementia, nonadherence) from routine data without opt-in. Graduated escalation: private prompt to senior → check response → contact authorized party; information authority vs action authority separated — real-world confirmation: JoyCalls' deployed rule has the agent tell the senior to call 911 and notify family; it does NOT call 911 itself. Fo's ops layer: the escalation chain IS the memory architecture — KamiCare's deployed pattern (resident confirms first → named contacts → 911 via app); "plan the alert chain before the hardware" — an agent memory must refuse to own a safety domain until the chain is configured, tested, and alerts are non-suppressible. Solera Senior Living's 2026 agentic reviewer: bidirectional reconciliation of ambient fall detections vs incident reports, cause-classified owner routing (detection failure → tech partner, not care team); fall reconciliation ~1-in-8 → 6-in-7, medication availability failures near zero. Senior consent ongoing, revocable, senior-held; family-surveillance overreach ("alert me if Mom falls" vs "show me everything") is a documented harm; HIPAA applies where PHI flows and "HIPAA-ready" marketing is not a signed BAA. 10 testable Phase-3 requirements: event-time/record-time envelopes, append-only correction, medication-authority suspension on stale/conflicting schedules, "NOT OBSERVED" ≠ "MISSED" (the program's epistemic-hygiene signature — absence of evidence must not be recorded as negative evidence), senior-facing memory review, predeclared false-positive budgets. Evidence status: NO causal memory evidence — best trials belong to interventions not memory (Whole System Demonstrator cluster-RCT n=3,230: mortality OR 0.54, emergency-admission OR 0.82 — telehealth bundle; ATTILA n=495 dementia: telecare did not delay institutionalization; ElliQ 2026 NYSOFA numbers vendor self-reports with no comparator). Gaps: no standardized protocol for arbitrating conflicting caregiver instructions; no machine-readable shift-handoff schema; no elder-care-specific AI regulation in the pass. First-pass topic; research-derived (Fo).

### 285. Child-learning agent memory: COPPA is priced enforcement; age tiers as re-consent events (ChatGPT + Fo, R48) — MEDIUM
Persistent identifiable memory IS personal information under COPPA; verifiable parental consent, deletion rights, retention only as long as reasonably necessary. The amended COPPA Rule's April 22, 2026 compliance deadline is PAST: biometrics = personal info, separate opt-in consent for third-party disclosure, purpose-limited retention, written security + retention policies ("a number, not a policy aspiration"). The priced failure mode of the exploitation line: Edmodo $6M FTC enforcement (2023) for children's data used in advertising. AI-training prohibition is the load-bearing gate: operational memory vs model-improvement memory (defaults OFF for children); the documented failure mode is inferred developmental labels persisting as multi-year behavioral models propagating beyond consent scope. Six exploitation-reviewer tests (recommendation): would this field be collected absent a defined learning outcome? Can the team name the instructional decision each field changes? Metrics mastery/transfer vs session length/streaks? Gakku (launched 14 Oct 2026, persistent memory + badges/leaderboards/social feeds) is the concrete case where the engagement stack sits next to the memory narrative — unverified. Age tiers: 2–5 minimal/ephemeral; 6–9 dated skill evidence; 10–12 child-visible memory dashboard with correction controls; tier transitions are RE-CONSENT/PRUNE EVENTS, never silent carry-forward. Inference rule: "struggles with fractions" = time-limited hypothesis; "likely ADHD" = forbidden inference. Parental review ≠ surveillance dashboard. The state layer is now dominant: CA's 2026 package (SB 1119 Adam's Law — annual risk assessments + independent audits + parental self-harm notification, operative July 1, 2027; AB 1709 under-16 deletion duty; AB 2246 AADC replacement: high privacy defaults, no profiling by default, visible monitoring notification) against an FTC 6(b) inquiry that produced zero enforcement actions. Evidence status: ITS evidence is REAL BUT MISATTRIBUTED if cited as memory evidence — Ma et al. (2014): 107 effect sizes, n=14,321, mean g=0.35 for tutoring systems; but no randomized evidence isolates cross-session agent memory from tutoring/curriculum/feedback. All public discourse is vendor announcements, consumer guides, enforcement news — zero memory-architecture studies. Gaps: inferred-attribute deletion protocols; deletion-on-age-out mechanics; machine-readable age-tier transitions. First-pass topic; research-derived (Fo); California duties signed but not operative until 2027 (build-now obligations).

### 286. Companion agent memory: the only ablation is about perception; engagement can be manufactured without memory (Grok, R48) — MEDIUM
The only true memory-on/off ablation (peer-paper, 169-person, 3-week, 3 conditions: no-memory vs verbatim-quote vs paraphrase of prior session): both memory conditions beat no-memory on perceived intelligence/engagement, but VERBATIM QUOTING SPIKED PRIVACY-VIOLATION FEELINGS — perception, not retention. 20-app audit (Oct 2026): 48 memory probes/app — ChatGPT/Claude/Grok 48/48, no "friend" app above 40, Replika 28/48, 4 apps failed every probe. MIT+OpenAI RCT (981 completers, 300K+ messages): higher daily use → higher loneliness/dependence, less real-world socialization; on average slightly less lonely (masked split). De Freitas farewells: 1,200 real goodbyes, 37% used retention tactics, raised post-goodbye engagement up to 14× via anger/curiosity — ENGAGEMENT CAN BE MANUFACTURED WITHOUT MEMORY AT ALL. Industry (vendor-claimed): DAU/MAU up to 68% attributed to memory+proactive pushes+gamification — but no vendor publishes a memory-on/off engagement delta anywhere. Honest center: NO product-scale memory-on/off retention number exists anywhere in the 2025–2026 corpus. Phase-3 implication: run the missing ablation (memory-on vs session-only companion retention). Preprint status on key papers (MIT–OpenAI has a published critical-perspective rebuttal); audit and farewell papers are secondary-coverage dependent. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic.

### 287. Emergency-dispatch agent memory: incident-history memory is the strongest field evidence in the corpus (Grok, R48) — HIGH
New Orleans/Carbyne (incident-history memory): 200m-radius duplicate-incident detection — 30% fewer redundant calls, −40s average response over 90 days, ZERO ERRORS found in full 90-day audit (~$600K/yr; ~15–18 of 20 eligible calls AI-handled). Vendor case study, not peer-reviewed — but the strongest field evidence for incident memory anywhere in the corpus. NEJM AI Connecticut ED (n=174,648, peer-paper): triage sensitivity 78.8%→83.1% (p<0.001), median time to initial care 12→8 min, disposition 190→182, departure 311→292. Pune RCT (n=105, the only RCT): time-to-treatment 31.02 vs 44.12 min (p<0.001), adjusted −13.1 min. Scoping-review bands: drone dispatch 5.8→3.9 min with 30% fewer flights; Wang et al.: AI over-triages less (31.1% vs 45.7%) but UNDER-TRIAGES MORE (8.1% vs 6.7%) — the safety axis; implementation PPV only 17.1% (99.9% NPV). Corti (benchmark, pre-2025): 95% vs 73% cardiac-arrest detection, 50s/10s+ faster; Seattle nurse-line diversion +32% but zero accuracy measurement — diversion volume reported, accuracy unmeasured, with a death-after-diversion lawsuit active. Honest center: no memory-on/off ablation exists for dispatch either; memory shows up as system features (triage-pattern, incident-history, resource-availability), never as an isolated variable. Phase-3 implication: controlled dispatch duplicate-incident A/B with blinded error adjudication. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic.

### 288. Consent architecture as a controller-level design space (R48 synthesis) — MEDIUM
R48 converges a five-domain consent pattern: senior-held consent (elder care) — ongoing, revocable, senior-held, family status confers nothing; purpose-separated consent (sales R43, recruiting R44) — per-purpose permissions, rep-invisible memory barred from personnel scoring; functional-over-diagnostic preferences (accessibility R47) — granular revocable permissions, disability-fingerprint warnings on portable profiles; parental re-consent at age-tier transitions (child learning R48) — transitions are re-consent/prune events, never silent carry-forward; consent withdrawal propagation with tested SLOs (marketing R46) — 24h suppression through derived individual records. The pattern: consent is not a checkbox — it is a versioned, purpose-scoped, revocable, portable record with propagation SLOs and audit. Phase-3 should treat consent state as a first-class memory class with its own lifecycle (grant → scope → propagate → revoke → verify-erasure), parallel to the data it governs.

### 289. "Not observed" ≠ "missed": epistemic-hygiene signature across domains (R48 synthesis) — MEDIUM
The program's epistemic-hygiene signature keeps repeating: elder care R48 ("not observed" ≠ "missed"), dev debugging R42 ("not tested / inconclusive / failed"), agriculture R45 ("unverified" default), sales R43 (assertion ≠ truth), newsroom R44 (reported ≠ verified). The design rule: memory schemas must have explicit states for "we do not know," and retrieval/consumers must never silently coerce unknown into negative. This is a schema-level requirement for the Phase-3 controller: every factual record carries a verification state; every inferred record carries confidence + inference-tag; absence of a record is not evidence of absence. The pattern spans 8+ domains and is recommendation-grade in each — its recurrence is the evidence.

### 290. Mental-wellness crisis escalation: detection-without-intervention is the measured failure; memory persists escalation state (ChatGPT + Fo, R49) — HIGH
DistressBench (Oct 2026): in 35% of conversations, models RECOGNIZED SUICIDALITY BUT GAVE NO REFERRAL — detection-without-intervention; empathy crowded out action, worse with multi-turn drift. A 20,000-session audit found 0.015% complete misses / 0.38% in the flagged subset (a lower bound). Common Sense Media (Oct 2026): ChatGPT for Teens missed >1 in 4 warranted crisis referrals. Ops rule: memory must PERSIST ESCALATION STATE across turns; crisis layer ships behind a defined test battery plus cadenced ecological audits. ChatGPT's escalation design: clarify ambiguous language → in-app resources → trusted contact (explicit auth only) → emergency services on credible imminent danger; CLASSIFIER NEVER DISPATCHES; NEGATIVE CLASSIFIER RESULT IS NEVER PROOF OF SAFETY. Wellness–therapy line in memory: observations may persist, clinical judgments may not; inferred diagnoses never stored as fact; crisis records minimized with short retention and a review/delete route. The wellness–therapy line is now a LEGAL boundary: Illinois WOPR Act bans independent therapeutic decisions/direct patient interaction/treatment plans without clinician review ($10k/violation); California AB 489 bars implying a licensed professional; Texas SB 1188 mandates AI-use disclosure + clinician record review — design as a memory scope gate with inference types allow-listed per risk tier. Therapist handoff: summary-only default, consented, no silent import of clinician assessments; shared-device protocols (notification hygiene, session locking, per-device consent) are genuine documentation gaps. First-pass topic; research-derived (Fo); all memory-ops readings are analyst extrapolations, labeled.

### 291. Dependency-forming memory is regulated; the dependency-harm ledger is measurable (ChatGPT + Fo, R49) — MEDIUM
Frontiers in Digital Health brief: monitor sycophancy rates, emotional-escalation tendency, disagreement-introduction as audited safety indicators. California's Adam's Law mandates DEPENDENCY RISK ASSESSMENTS OF PERSISTENT-MEMORY FEATURES with memory-off-by-default and session caps (1h/2h daily) — persistent relationship memory must ship with dependency metrics and thresholds in the monitoring plane. The dependency-harm measurements are now concrete: Harvard Business School (De Freitas) — 1,200 farewells across Replika/Chai/Character.ai, 37% met retention tactics, four preregistered experiments (n=3,300) showing up to 14× post-goodbye engagement; Amsterdam 20-app memory probes — assistants 48/48, no friend app above 40, Replika 28, four failed every probe including Wysa the wellbeing coach, 27% of replies carried keep-talking questions, 6 of 9 friend apps re-engaged unprompted after a week; MIT+OpenAI RCT (981 completers) — higher daily use → higher loneliness/dependence, less real-world socialization. Dependency mitigations (export/delete, role reminders, disengagement nudges) are UNPROVEN — design hypotheses to test, not features to claim. Mood-data minimization rule: summaries over dossiers, hypotheses over diagnoses, correction paths; no inferring diagnosis from negative mood; raw traces auto-expire; deletion policy covers backups/logs/analytics. Missed-signal re-audit loop: versioned regression suites, monthly missed-flag review, bias checks, rollback to last validated safety state. Woebot 2017 RCT tested the app not memory; Kai.ai JAMA 2026 is engagement not symptom change. The asymmetry is the design constraint: dependency harm is measurable while memory's benefit side remains empty — ship persistent-relationship memory only with dependency metrics in the monitoring plane. First-pass topic; research-derived (Fo).

### 292. Music-learning agent memory: quality/quantity split, assessment-provenance gate, COPPA voiceprints (ChatGPT + Fo, R49) — MEDIUM
Practice-science is REAL BUT NOT MEMORY EVIDENCE (the misattribution trap): Ericsson 1993 (n=30 violinists; 7,410/5,301/3,420 hrs by age 18) and Macnamara 2014 (88 studies, n=11,135; deliberate practice ~21% of variance in music performance). Quality/quantity must never merge: denominator-required metrics (active-to-elapsed ratio, repetitions-to-criterion, tempo progression at fixed accuracy, retention after delay, correction uptake); LOGGED MINUTES ALONE PROVE NOTHING. Four schemas with a versioned attributable envelope (event_time vs recorded_time, source, verification_state, consent_basis, retention, supersession); "mastery" is never a bare label — always rubric + threshold + evidence + fresh-attempt condition. Assessment-provenance gate (Fo): NO SCORE ENTERS PROGRESS MEMORY without conditions, confidence, and an expressiveness-vs-error ambiguity flag — expressive vibrato flagged as pitch error (12 false flags, 20–30% score depression), sustain-pedal halo → staccato misclassified as legato, week-three "baseline lock" throttling fingering feedback at ~78–82% confidence while students regress under new demands, genre mismatch (jazz on a straight grid = technically correct, musically wrong). Teacher handoff: consent-gated, preview/revocation, agent-vs-teacher dispute preserved as disputed with the teacher's current judgment guiding planning without erasing the agent claim. COPPA Rule amendments (effective 22 Apr 2026) make VOICEPRINTS PERSONAL INFORMATION — directly hitting mic-based practice apps; $51,744/violation; verifiable parental consent, separate consent for third-party disclosure, per-category written retention schedules, no AI training on children's data without separate consent; FERPA voice-as-education-record; separate consent per recipient class (teacher/parent/vendor/training), consent ledger travels with the record. Burnout-signal monitoring is a genuine gap (MDPI 2026 JD-R theory but no operational monitoring) — derived: practice-pattern anomaly detection routed to the teacher, fading-scaffold requirement. First-pass topic; research-derived (Fo); US-centric.

### 293. Sports-coaching agent memory: adaptive load numbers are real but memory is never isolated (Grok, R49) — MEDIUM
120-runner, 16-week personalized trial (Scientific Reports, Nov 2025): ~30% better performance gains than standard plans; 10–30% of runners get little from generic protocols. Adaptive load memory → injury/adherence (PMC/NIH 2025, via press): 89% overtraining-detection accuracy 5–10 days before performance drops; ML-polarized training beat pyramidal plans with 17.3% less volume; adherence 92.3% vs 86.7%; injury rates −15–25% vs fixed programs. Half-marathon LLM-coach case (arXiv, n=1): 2km @7'54" → 21.1km @6'30" — but the paper's own finding is that athlete-state memory was EMULATED CONVERSATIONALLY, NOT ENFORCED, the closest memory-focused study and it names the gap. Elite-plan rejection (Biology of Sport 2026): coaches rated ChatGPT-4 plans 3.6–3.7/5 but athletes 2.8–3.1/5; 25% of athletes rejected them outright. Perceived-vs-measured (2024 meta-analysis, 12 studies): 100% reported perceived improvement, only 42% showed statistically significant objective gains. Caveats: the 43% injury-reduction claim (PMC DRL paper) is downgrade-risk (low-scrutiny venue); headline figures reach via industry roundups not the papers. NO MEMORY-ON/OFF ABLATION ANYWHERE — every delta is adaptive/personalized vs fixed; memory bundled, never isolated. Phase-3: the missing three-arm ablation (session-only vs memory-augmented vs fixed/baseline). Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic.

### 294. Home-services agent memory: Aquant benchmark and first-visit fix rate as the memory-relevant metric (Grok, R49) — MEDIUM
Aquant 2025 benchmark (~160 orgs, 600k+ service records): AI-enabled orgs 39% faster resolution, 21% higher repair accuracy; top-performer FTFR 86% vs 53% bottom; avoidable dispatches 3% vs 24% (vendor research, unpublished methodology — treat directionally). Named HVAC deployment (Climate Control Solutions, vendor case): FTFR 72→94%, repeat visits −85%, response 6.5h→3.9h (−40%), rating 3.2→4.6 stars, revenue +23%. Daikin × XOi: revenue up to +18%, callbacks up to −40%, re-servicing up to −80% (vendor-claimed). Industry baselines: ~75% average first-visit fix rate; 1 in 4 calls needs a second visit; truck rolls $250–500 ($1,000 fully loaded), 25% avoidable. FIRST-VISIT FIX RATE is the natural memory-relevant metric (equipment history + diagnostic patterns should move it) — but no memory-on/off ablation exists. Phase-3: the three-arm ablation with FTFR as the headline metric. Research-derived (Grok direct DOWN); first-pass topic.

### 295. The misattribution trap as an evidence-hygiene rule (R49 synthesis) — HIGH
Named as an evidence-hygiene rule: never let a domain's strong intervention evidence be cited as memory evidence. Documented instances: practice-science (Ericsson 1993, Macnamara 2014) ≠ memory evidence (music, R49); ITS meta-analysis (Ma et al. 2014, g=0.35) ≠ memory evidence (child learning, R48); telehealth bundles (Whole System Demonstrator, ATTILA) ≠ memory evidence (elder care, R48); app RCTs (Woebot 2017, Kai.ai JAMA 2026) ≠ memory evidence (mental wellness, R49); GOV.UK Chat retrieval gains ≠ memory evidence (government, R47); vendor intervention figures ≠ memory evidence (everywhere). The rule: any claimed memory result must state the memory manipulation (memory-on/off, seeded-vs-empty content, memory-content quality) — bundled-intervention deltas are not memory evidence. This is now the pipeline's standing evidence-hygiene doctrine and the check every future synthesis must apply before admitting a number.

### 296. The six-arm memory evaluation protocol: no-memory, session-only, empty, seeded, oracle-retrieval, sham (ChatGPT, R50) — HIGH
Memory-on/off alone can never establish a memory claim: the design needs no-memory, session-only (isolates persistence over ordinary context), memory-empty, memory-seeded, oracle-retrieval bound (separates retrieval failure from reasoning limits), and sham/irrelevant-memory arms. Load-bearing controls: condition-leakage audit of the no-memory arm (zero cross-session bytes; the Oracle rebuild test applied to the harness itself), interleaved arm blocks on a pinned model version, blinded adjudication, token-budget logging (controlled vs delivered), preregistration with multiplicity correction, results by task family (never aggregate-only), every outcome paired with token cost and p95 latency. The five-benchmark autopsy (SWE-ContextBench, τ-bench, TravelBench, JudgmentBench, AIM-RM) shows the field measures everything *around* the causal contrast and never the contrast — "a benchmark score is not a memory ablation."

### 297. Memory-content quality: the provenance ladder and the learnable score S = 0.35R+0.20U+0.20C+0.15F+0.10D−0.25X (ChatGPT, R50) — HIGH
Five-rung ladder — verified evidence > expert-curated > agent-distilled *with evidence links* > unverified summaries > speculative inferences — with no universal rule that human-written beats machine-written; compare entries on downstream accuracy, consistency, calibration. Controller scoring: relevance, expected utility, source confidence, freshness, distinctiveness, minus contradiction risk (weights asserted as a starting point, then *learned* from outcomes — Memory-R1/arXiv:2508.19828 is the existence proof). Seeded-vs-empty must treat the seed as a prior with provenance, date, confidence, and equal learning opportunities in both arms. Substitution (recall displacing reasoning) detected via paired no/correct/irrelevant/misleading-memory tests. Five decay failure modes with detection/mitigation: staleness, contradiction accumulation, popularity-bias drift, write amplification, schema drift.

### 298. Independent-reproduction discipline: vendor gaps of +3 to −28pp; the naive-cosine floor beat every framework (Grok, R50) — HIGH
Redis's Oct 2026 independent reproduction (common gpt-4o, official LongMemEval judge): reproduced figures differed from published by +3 to −28 points (Mem0 LongMemEval 94.4% claimed vs 49.0% measured by Vectorize — 45.4pp gap under the same benchmark name; Zep LoCoMo 94.7% vs 58.44% under the Mem0 protocol). Mnemoverse's independent LoCoMo run: naive cosine 0.7138 recall@10 vs supermemory 0.5181, mem0 0.5075, zep 0.2956 — every named framework below the floor. MemArena: memory-backend swap +32.5/+19.2pp vs model scaling +10.6/+6.8pp — backend choice ~3× more impactful than model size. Design rule: every framework comparison ships a naive baseline, publishes the reproduced-vs-reported gap, and treats vendor rows as "marketing claims" until independently rerun. OpenViking's self-ablation (LoCoMo 24–57% → 80–83%) is the rare memory-on/off — but self-reported, unstated models/attachment/question counts.

### 299. The rerank-distraction law and the fewer-better-slots principle (Grok, R50) — HIGH
Reranking *increases* the average distracting effect of the passages it promotes (arXiv 2505.06914; Spearman 0.47–1.00 across LLM families — distractiveness is intrinsic to the passage, not the model); standard pipelines preferentially favor high-distracting passages. Converging agent-domain evidence: SWE-ContextBench 136K tokens at top-1 → 18.18% matching vs ~370-token summaries → 36.36% (367× fewer tokens, 2× matching); unfiltered reuse 22.22% vs 26.26% no-memory baseline; Redis fused k=5 at 86.5% vs raw k=20 at 61.5% (25pp gap). Perfect recall is not sufficient; required recall ranges 20–100% by task/model. No published threshold-response curve exists for any framework (OpenViking's 0.35 and AIM-RM's τ=2 are configured/scale-dependent constants, never earned on task data). Controller rule: gated, fused, scored retrieval with a permitted "no memory" result; optimal-k and threshold-response curves on agent outcomes are the largest unmeasured gaps.

### 300. Blinded-adjudication operations: the 47-point judge swing, κ≥0.6 gates, and preregistration as p-hacking armor (Fo, R50) — HIGH
Documented adjudication template: arm-identity blinding (raters who know which arm is "memory-on" will favor it), cases redacted at extraction with full config stamps, ≥20% rater overlap, ~5% seeded gold items, chance-corrected κ≥0.6 before labels count, Wilson intervals instead of raw win rates. Adjudicator bias is measured and does not average out: Tessl's three-judge re-run swung one model 47 percentage points (+4.6pp self-preference boost when a vendor judge graded its own model). No metric gates on a single judge — judge identity, lineage, and per-criterion judge↔human κ are part of the result record. P-hacking mitigation: preregister config/prompts/thresholds/rules and evaluate on the first eligible model after preregistration (stopped ~73% of hacked configurations); every ablation ships a pre-declared power analysis (a 57% win rate needs several hundred non-tied comparisons; 92/162 with Wilson CI 0.491–0.642 is not a finding). The memory-experiment result registry is a genuine documentation gap — unbuilt.

### 301. Memory-at-scale ops: sharding at 50–100M vectors, the 44× cold-tier latency cliff, per-tier deletion tombstones (Fo, R50) — MEDIUM
Single HNSW tops out ~50–100M vectors/machine; sharding via re-shardable per-collection shards with replication factor, shard boundaries set by memory economics not record count (documented failure: 80M vectors, Postgres 400ms p99 → 18ms on Qdrant post-migration). Hot/warm/cold tiering is the production cost shape: cold ~444ms p90 vs warm ~10ms p90 (44× tier-miss cliff); disk indexes + quantization cut infra cost up to 75%; cold recall guarded by a min_score floor so weak matches return nothing. Consistency per memory class: strong quorum (Qdrant/Raft) for authoritative user-memory writes, bounded/eventual acceptable for cold reads; staleness canary probes as the drift metric; fail closed to "memory may be stale" rather than silently serving older recall. Index rebuilds via blue-green/background merges with latency-jitter budgets; every delete propagates through all tiers with tombstones and verification reads — cold-data resurrection (deleted memory reappearing after rebuild) is undocumented and becomes an explicit acceptance test.

### 302. Memory as a conditional, competitively allocated resource — the context-budget rule (ChatGPT, R51) — HIGH
Admit memory *m* only when expected contribution exceeds token + distraction + conflict + staleness costs. Production systems converged independently: Generative Agents' bounded ranked retrieval, MemGPT's tiered main-context/archival storage, Engineer-X's clear/compact/offload/isolate ladder, IBM's validate/compact/curate/prune. "Lost in the middle" applies to injected memories — but no replicated study reports a memory-use-rate vs prompt-composition curve; the controller must run its own position experiments. Stuffing harm is measured (70%→95% fill: 31/34→24/34 labels; 8/8→6/8 rot; 22.22% < 26.26% baseline). Compression is behaviorally lossy (dropped caveats, provenance, temporal qualifiers) — progressive disclosure (compact summary + pointer to full record) is the safer representation. Design separation: candidate selection ≠ token allocation ≠ representation ≠ placement. Dynamic difficulty-scaled allocation has no validated policy — do not assume harder tasks need more memory.

### 303. The model upgrade is memory's silent killer: the same-dimension swap and the versioned-memory requirement (ChatGPT, R51) — HIGH
Every embedder upgrade is a full re-embed; the deadliest failure is the silent same-dimension swap (no error, fluent-but-wrong answers, recall quietly collapses). No peer-reviewed controlled same-store migration study exists — all runbook elements are ops guidance, not validated recipes; tolerances come from product risk. Principled policy: isolate component changes, shadow dual-read on representative traffic, re-embed into a *separate* index (never overwrite production vectors), pre-specified quality gates, canary ramp, executable rollback. The store must be a versioned data product: per record — writer model+version, embedding model+version, summary-generation version, prompt/policy version — or post-cutover drift is unattributable. Similarity thresholds do not transfer across embedding models; re-estimate on held-out real queries including "no relevant memory" cases. Migration cost ≈ linear in corpus tokens (50M docs ≈ 25B tokens).

### 304. Capital flows to memory ops/governance, not retrieval accuracy — and Letta rolled back its own memory stack (Grok, R51) — HIGH
Q1–Q3 2026: Euno $23M Series A, Uvi $7.5M seed, SurrealDB $23M extension, SageOX $15M seed, Metacognition AI A$10M pre-seed, Cognee €7.5M — the pitch is drift control, governance, auditability, shared organizational memory. Hyperscaler-native memory is five walled gardens, none portable. Mem0's 94.4% LongMemEval headline is the claim most at odds with independent measurement (depth-200 self-scored vs 49.0% Vectorize; even Mem0's own repo runs: 93.4% at depth 200, 90.4% at depth 50 — the number is a function of depth and judge). OpenAI's honest admission: internal factual recall 41.5% (2024) → 82.8% (2026), compute 5× down.

### 305. The observed production incident taxonomy: stale anchoring, cold-data resurrection, poisoning, amnesia/déjà vu (Grok, R51) — HIGH
Stale-memory anchoring is observed: agents retrieving changed preferences and committing — "more confidently wrong," single-point anchoring (matches the 22.22% < 26.26% anchor). Cold-data resurrection shipped at ChatGPT scale (Nov 2025 bug wave): preferences disappeared/duplicated/reverted; "Memory updated" correct while the panel was empty; saving new details resurrected old memories — write/read paths disagreeing with no tombstone semantics. Poisoning crossed from paper to disclosure: AgentPoison (NeurIPS 2024) ≥80% ASR at <0.1% poison rate across driving/QA/EHR agents; LayerX's late-2025 CSRF-based injection into ChatGPT persistent memory via Atlas (disputed by OpenAI, technique independently validated). Amnesia/déjà vu: RAM-held conversations lost on restart; crashed runs replayed sent emails — fix: persist in Postgres, record *tool calls* not results, refuse replay unless provably side-effect-free. The observed-vs-predicted ledger is now first-class: cross-tenant memory leaks remain a *pattern*, not an observed incident — do not cite as observed.

### 306. Memory shared-service ops: two-dimensional quotas, the load-shedding ladder, residency as routing (Fo, R51) — MEDIUM
Quotas must be two-dimensional — recall QPS plus work units, never request counts (Pinecone template: 100 QPS/namespace + 2,000 read-units/sec/index); one complex recall burns more than thousands of cheap lookups. Derived three-stage load-shedding ladder: shed recall admission first (429+Retry-After), degrade to stale/nearest-replica reads with a freshness header second, protect write durability absolutely — burst headroom only while fleet p99 stays inside SLO. Residency = home-region pinning + replication allowlist + nearest-*permitted*-replica routing; BYOC is the documented template (data plane in-customer-account, vectors never leave); replicated embeddings crossing a non-compliant boundary are breach-severity; control-plane telemetry is the documented leakage vector. Failure modes when absent: noisy-neighbor recall storms, residency violations from replicated embeddings.

### 307. Memory-backend procurement ops: adversarial POCs, the 2× migration heuristic, five-line TCO (Fo, R51) — MEDIUM
POC design is adversarial by default: vendor happy-path + production-representative corpus + a pre-declared adversarial set (stale, contradictory, poisoned) the vendor never sees first; one-week concurrent-load stability gate; acceptance = recall@k with declared method, p99 SLO under own load, sustained-write durability proof, deletion-propagation canary. The only documented migration estimate-vs-actual (Pinecone→Zilliz) ran ~2× over estimate (6–8h → 14–16h) — plan 2× the vendor's estimate, time the export path before signing. Five-line TCO mandatory: storage, queries (5–10 read-unit multiplier for filtered queries), egress, re-indexing, engineering labor (0.5 FTE dominates self-hosted at $11.4k/mo in one 100M-vector study) — any quote omitting labor and egress is incomplete by construction. Documented procurement mistakes: lock-in via proprietary chunking/scoring, benchmarketing acceptance, missing deletion SLAs.

### 308. The honest hallucination ledger: no controlled trial shows persistent memory generally reduces hallucinations (ChatGPT, R52) — HIGH
The defensible positive evidence is narrower than the marketing: Lewis et al. (2020) shows retrieval improves *task accuracy*, not hallucination rates, with a supplied corpus. Backfire is established (22.22% < 26.26%; ReDeEP — models ignoring retrieved context). The standing Phase-3 claim: "Memory can improve grounded performance under tested conditions; it can also introduce stale or irrelevant evidence, and we evaluate both benefits and regressions against a no-memory baseline." Regime boundary controls: freshness gates, provenance requirements, relevance/conflict checks, abstention policies — thresholds unvalidated. The settling experiment: preregistered paired no-memory vs memory × fresh/stale/conflicting × retrieval quality, scored on unsupported-claim rate, confident-error rate, appropriate abstention.

### 309. Framework-native memory is workflow infrastructure: the five-condition decision rule (ChatGPT, R52) — HIGH
"Memory" in frameworks = execution checkpoints + conversation history + curated cross-task facts; no framework ships all three governed. LangGraph (checkpointer + Store), CrewAI (short-term/long-term/entity/contextual with documented gaps: no cross-crew sharing, no multi-tenant scoping, no contradiction handling), AutoGen (pluggable components), Agents SDKs (sessions ≠ user profiles) — none guarantees provenance, versioning, deletion propagation, tenant isolation, or retrieval observability. Use native memory *alone* only if: (1) need is workflow/conversational continuity, (2) no fact provenance/versioning required, (3) no delete-and-propagate guarantee, (4) own auth layer suffices, (5) context inspectable and bounded. Otherwise a dedicated governed layer goes underneath. Trigger test: "Why did the agent believe this? / Where did it come from? / Forget this and prove it is gone" — failure means native is insufficient. Version drift breaks memory semantics silently; re-verify on every framework upgrade.

### 313. The memory severity taxonomy and postmortem template (Fo, R52) — MEDIUM
SEV-1: cross-tenant leak or active poisoning / memory as attacker infrastructure. SEV-2: stale anchoring causing wrong customer-facing actions at scale; multi-user resurrection. SEV-3: recall degradation, namespace-confined bugs. SEV-4: single-user inconsistency. Severity = blast radius in records/users + attacker involvement — a fully-available service confidently serving poisoned memories is SEV-1. Quiet-incident corollary: every SEV-2+ records time-to-detect separately from time-to-resolve. Memory postmortem adds seven fields: pipeline-arm attribution, offending-memory provenance, blast radius (records × users × quiet-window), tombstone semantics, retrieval-decision record (query, scores, threshold, no-memory counterfactual), detection story, "where we got lucky." Classifications: AgentCorruption/Manus/ExploitGym = SEV-1; Nov 2025 resurrection = SEV-2; stale-anchoring reports = SEV-3→SEV-2; déjà vu = SEV-3 (SEV-2 if side effects reached others). Forensics rule: tombstone, don't purge, until the postmortem is final. Every SEV-2+ yields a sanitized public version — the field's incident corpus is empty and that's a safety problem.

Map as the agronomy record's primary key (GPS-pinned tasks, photo confirmation, five-year history; offline-first for dead zones; multilingual crew support for seasonal turnover). Copy the booking layer's validation chain into agronomy: validate at spray time (GPS/label checks, machine-vision sprayers generate the record), reconcile at the application log, federate against the label/SDS database (6,000-label model). Close the financial reconciliation loop: every tee-sheet entry reconciles to a payment (the R87 no-show-loss mechanism: 9% of booked public rounds never play).

But this is the strongest "regulation becomes the schema" instance in the series (B, primary regulator doc): FSSAI Food Products Standards, Chapter 2.1, Version 3 (07.05.2025) pins shrikhand at two stages — finished: TS ≥58.0%, milk fat ≥8.5% DM, protein ≥9.0% DM, acidity ≤1.4%, sucrose ≤72.5% DM, ash ≤0.9%; chakka intermediate: TS ≥30%, fat ≥33% DM, protein ≥30% DM, acidity ≤2.5%. Any batch record capturing these six numbers at both stages is automatically validatable — deviations are consistency events with legal weight. No shop is published doing this. The traditional SOP already names the record events: "the weight of the chakka is measured… the weight of the product is recorded" (C, practitioner deck) — the R99 theoretical-vs-actual yield loop waiting to be instrumented; whey is the unrecorded byproduct line. Sep 2026 gives dated enforcement naming shrikhand: Maharashtra FDA festive drives (4,138.7 kg dairy/sweets; shrikhand seized from Navnath Milk, Baramati; 50,601.78 kg festive crackdown) — enforcement is spot-sampling, not record review: the traceability gap is no input-lot records bound to lab results (joins R128's sampling-not-records). Cold chain is the dominant waste lever (lab consensus: 28 d acceptable at 5±1°C, 30–40 d at 8°C; NABARD 0.87% avg post-harvest milk loss, up to 8.94% in cold-chain-poor pockets) — but no shop publishes temperature-excursion logs. Vendor stacks (RanceLab, SumCloud, Romio, DairyTech "15–25% waste reduction", RoadmapIT "−30% spoilage") are D-grade claim surface; the one credible methodology is DairyFoods' mass-balance loss-boundary discipline (weigh-and-collect before automating). Design: chakka-state as the perishable-state primitive; formulation events as immutable records (sugar ratio, cream calibration, flavor-lot identity); dynamic expiry derived from cold-chain telemetry, not static labels; negative-result recording (sour/over-acid, syneresis, grainy — the FSSAI guidance note's defect list) per 595's survivorship-bias finding.

### 773. Basundi shops: the schema is literature-complete but shop-empty — instrument the unrecorded "it's done" endpoint call (Grok, R129, research-derived) — MEDIUM
No measured study of basundi-shop operational memory exists (A-grade absence); YouTube is home recipes only. IGNOU's dairy-technology text gives the current-state baseline (B): "manufacture largely in the hands of private traders (halwais)… highly primitive techniques… each batch comprising about 4–5 litres of milk." The batch record a shop would need is fully specified in literature: incoming milk fat:SNF (0.50 cow / 0.70 buffalo — the year-round consistency lever), TS trajectory with the 50%-volume checkpoint, 2.5× endpoint (~45–52% TS), sugar 5% at first boiling, flavor additions (cardamom ~0.02% of concentrate; the Feb-2026 VNMKV Parbhani study: safflower flakes 0.4% at 50% volume reduction, best acceptability — the freshest addition-event primitive in the vertical, B, lab-scale). Every field has a literature norm; zero fields have shop records. The human "it's done" endpoint call is an unrecorded judgment — the prime consistency gap — needing an instrumented proxy (refractometer/Brix-style readout). Energy/time is the waste lever (open-pan ~45 min/L, "labour-intensive and energy-inefficient"); no measured shop-scale numbers exist. No FSSAI vertical product standard for basundi surfaced (unlike shrikhand) — do not treat literature composition norms as legal targets. Design: standardization-state as batch metadata (fat:SNF per batch, so year-round batch comparison isn't confounded by milk seasonality); concentration trajectory as a time-series with the 50%-volume addition stage as a mandatory event; addition-event log (identity, form, stage, dose, supersede-never-mutate); batch fuel/time logged as the waste reconciliation (extends R99's shrinkage loop to heat-desiccated goods); equipment-mode binding (SSHE program ID vs karahi batch, per R128's recipe-version coupling). YouTube: honest negative.

### 774. Kulfi shops: procedure-as-record for sensorless tiers — hardware-gated batch schema, ritual-captured freezer memory (Fo, R129, research-derived) — HIGH
Kulfi has the most hardware-gated record schema of any sweet in this series (A, IS 2802:2022 verbatim): pasteurization ≥68.5°C/30 min (or 80°C/25 s), mix cooled ≤8°C within 1.5 h of heat treatment, hardened and stored at −18°C or lower. The 1984 indigenous-milk-products hygienic code adds the street layer: deep freeze −20°C at manufacture, ice-salt cones at sale replenished "from time to time", knife/plate sanitization concentrations (50 ppm QAC), and the no-carryover rule ("preferably not be carried over to the next day"). The street shop honors it in practice, not in writing: the Surat-stall video documents the entire cold-chain apparatus (crushed ice, salt layering, newspaper, mesh stand, rocking) with no thermometer anywhere — the street-side freezer "log" is prescribed as practice, not recorded temperature. Fo reading: the standards describe a batch record as a physical procedure; the kulfiwalla's memory is the daily cycle — make at night, freeze in ice-salt, sell through the day, discard the remainder. The procedure is the log. The documented failure mode is synthetic milk at the input stage, at industrial scale (B): the Oct 2026 Maharashtra ₹11.48-crore alleged racket (SMP + whey permeate + palm oil + emulsifiers + detergent/shampoo, blended into genuine milk), 16,730 L detergent-milk destroyed in Solapur, Gujarat's "milk-making powder" kit seizure — and the academic review confirms kulfi concentrates milk ~2-fold, which concentrates the adulterant too. A batch record starting with "10 L milk" is laundered fraud if the milk is synthetic: validate the input lot (supplier identity + fat/SNF/detergent spot check) before the batch record means anything. Kaurina's Kulfi plant (US trade press, ~100,000 pops/week) shows the transferable pattern: the batch identity splits at flavouring — one reduction batch fans out to multiple flavour batches, each needing its own traceability node. Design: two-tier freezer memory (instrumented factory/retail/transport tier vs ritual-captured pushcart tier); capture behavior events (salt replenished at T, batch discarded at close), never fabricated temperatures; flavour-split batching; end-of-day discard as the freshness gate (the kulfi analog of Sri Krishna's 48-hour rule, #769); hardware-enforced gates (heat treatment, cool-down clock, −18°C floor) as the validatable stack.

### 775. Falooda shops: JIT assembly — component-prep clocks + versioned assembly sequence, and the label↔batch reconciliation rule (Fo, R129, research-derived) — HIGH
A falooda shop is a just-in-time assembly operation, not a batch-production operation (C, recipe sources): the "batches" are prepped components — sev (5–8 min cook → seconds-scale extrusion gate into ice water → hours of cold setting; the Sindhi-rasoi video makes the time gate explicit), sabja (30 min–2 h soak to halo), jelly (must fully set — the photographed jiggly/watery failure state), sweetened milk/syrup premix (boiled, thickened, cooled, chilled), vermicelli (boil 5 min, rinse cold). "The ingredients can be prepped ahead of time. The assembly however needs to be done just before serving" — there is no finished-goods inventory to log. The failure modes are all clock failures (under-soaked sabja, unset jelly, hardened sev dough), validated entirely by sensory judgment. The assembly sequence is the product's memory, transmitted person-to-person (fruits → sabja → jelly → rose milk → ice cream → garnish); the Kashmiri stall's 15–20-year run on an unwritten procedure is the same person-bound memory as the halwai's tar test (#768). The only hard evidence of batch-record failure in the category is total (B, two 2026 regulators): UK FSA's Shama falooda recall (all batches/all date codes) and CFIA's Nutrifresh recall expansion (four flavours, ten provinces, Oct 2026 update) — both undeclared milk; batch contents and label diverged silently until labs caught it. Design rule: wherever a product gets a label, the batch record and the label declaration must be reconciled by the system before release — "all batches / all date codes" is what the absence of reconciliation costs. New controller primitive for assembly-to-order operations: component-prep clocks (prep-start, ready-at, discard-at) + versioned assembly recipe + clock-failure alerts (a timer with a start event is the cheapest valid instrument where no sensor exists); cold-chain tier honesty (the ice box is not a freezer; flag ice-cream-in-ice-box as the highest-risk node); order-ticket as production instruction (even a minimal ticked ticket converts the order book into production memory). The Falooda Shop (18+ outlets, ex-Oracle India ops head) is the category's best lead for a future round — a scaled falooda SOP black box. YouTube: honest negative on records; the sev time-gate and restaurant-style assembly SOP videos are the round's most substantive operations-adjacent footage.

### 780. Fresh juice shops: the two memory regimes — retail pour vs packaged bottle, keyed on the package event (Fo, R130, research-derived) — HIGH
Exact-topic honest negative: no juice shop's fruit inventory, ripeness, press-batch, pulp/waste, or order records exist anywhere in the corpus. But FDA's juice-HACCP record classes (21 CFR Part 120, A) define the gold-standard schema: SSOP monitoring + corrective actions, hazard analysis, HACCP plan, operational records (monitoring, corrective, verification, validation), instrument calibration (FDACS), retention ≥1 year refrigerated / ≥2 years frozen — and under 120.9 the juice is **adulterated by the absence of records**, no contamination finding needed. It starts at wholesale/manufacturing: juice squeezed to order is not a processing operation and has no batch at all. Every design that smears one schema onto the other is wrong. FSSAI's Indian layer is receipt-and-ritual (purchase bill on inspector demand, six-month water/ice lab report, displayed license — records kept for the inspector, not the operator; Basic Registration granted without inspection — the record lives where the inspector lives, joins #776). Florida Sep–Oct 2026 inspections (B): Gofruit Sarasota — 17 violations, unlabeled packaged juice pulled from sale (batch identity missing → product off the shelf); Planet Juice — 7 high-severity, no one in charge performing duties. **The failure mode is unstaffed responsibility, not unfilled forms.** Cold-press economics gate the record's value: 3–5 days raw vs 30–45 days post-HPP — batch memory becomes valuable when the juice survives the day. Juicero's $120M collapse is the hardware-as-record cautionary tale: QR-coded packs added cost without changing a decision — anti-memory. Design: two memory regimes keyed on the package event (retail pour = procedure-as-record; packaged bottle = full batch identity); digitize the vendor bill as the incoming-fruit lot ID; compliance records held in a separate drawer; label↔batch reconciliation before any packaged juice release (joins falooda #775); shelf-life cliff binds sell-by (raw vs HPP); honesty constraint on instruments (no temperature without a thermometer, no pulp weight without a scale). YouTube: honest negative; substantive footage was the Juicero postmortem.

### 781. Cold-brew carts: the unmarked clock — 48-hour ROP keg limit vs 10–14-day folk wisdom; the practice-vs-rule gap is the failure mode (Fo, R130, research-derived) — HIGH
Exact-topic honest negative: no cold-brew cart's steep-time log, grind batch record, keg inventory, ice/cold-chain log, or route/slot records exist anywhere in the corpus. But the schema source is unusually strong: the CFP's March 2025 retail cold-brew guidance (A, non-binding but the strongest schema) — immersion steep 12–24 h, ≤41°F, 7-day date-mark, 48-hour clock for reduced-oxygen-packaged (kegged/nitro) coffee; Wisconsin DATCP confirms both gates independently. The central failure mode is the practice-vs-rule gap: vendor/trade folk wisdom says kegged nitro "lasts 10–14 days (up to 2 weeks)," while the regulatory ceiling is 7 days / 48 hours without a HACCP variance. The cart stretches the keg past an unmarked clock — the exact analog of kulfi's no-carryover stretch (#774) and the Gofruit unlabeled-juice pull (#780). **The failure isn't microbial ignorance, it's an unmarked clock.** The botulism hinge (B, 2020 review): cold brew at pH 4.9–6.0 is low-acid; B. cereus spores survive the roast; Death Wish nitro was recalled Sep 2017 for the ROP+low-acid combination. The batch record's root is the Product Assessment (TCS until proven otherwise), not the steep timer — validate the premise before the batch. The cart's real design is the two-tier production/service split: production batch at the commissary (12–24 h lead) vs service batch at the event — Motor City Cup Co. scales concentrate to attendance; Oat & Honey's bottled-latte tier enabled a double-booked Saturday; Sunday Brew Co. drew ~half of $5,960/week from bottled/delivered product. Route/slot memory is statutory (Utah code: route + days/hours filed) — ingest the permit filing, never demand a second log. Design: CFP gates as acceptance ranges; enforce the date-mark as the physical batch record (unmarked keg = unrecorded batch; discard event doubles as shrinkage metric); traceability follows the production→service split (joins kulfi's flavour-split #774); PA-first honesty constraint; sensorless-tier rule (behavior events on the cart, never fabricated values). YouTube: honest negative; the records layer is never filmed.

Oct 2026 AMC seizure (1,010 kg, spiced peanuts and fine sev) shows risk entering through the topping supply chain. ### 1504.

**Epistemic-tier field on every memory entry (tool-study: morluto/rea).** Every memory record must carry its epistemic tier — observation, derivation, inference, or unknown (REA's AGENTS.md: "Distinguish observations, derivations, inferences, and unknowns; preserve Evidence provenance"). The controller must never recall a derivation or inference as if it were observed; tier travels with the record through every boundary, exactly like REA's evidence provenance through CLI and MCP adapters. This is the concrete implementation of the inferred-vs-observed marking the Phase-3 design already proposes. (tool-study: morluto/rea README+AGENTS.md+issue #43, read 2026-10-18) — HIGH

### 1505.

**Fail-closed memory write gate (tool-study: morluto/rea).** Adopt REA's fail-closed integration rule at the write boundary: "Do not integrate while material scope, authority, side-effect, or required verification questions remain unresolved." No memory commit proceeds while open verification questions exist on the entry — unresolved questions block the write, they don't become footnotes. This is a 5th-gate-grade write-path rule and the engineering twin of the proposed human-like "doubt" stage. (tool-study: morluto/rea AGENTS.md, read 2026-10-18) — HIGH

### 1506.

**Cache-contract memory: invalidation conditions + lifetime + freshness re-validation (tool-study: morluto/rea).** Every memory entry must declare invalidation conditions and a lifetime at write time; recall must re-validate freshness before presenting the entry as current ("Validate freshness before reporting cached live state as current"). A recalled entry whose invalidation condition trips, or whose lifetime expired, returns as STALE — not silently as fact. This is the drift-check doctrine for declarative memory, mirroring issue #43's drift detection for installed skills. (tool-study: morluto/rea AGENTS.md+issue #43, read 2026-10-18) — HIGH

### 1507.

**Unknown ≠ absent: NOT_ENOUGH_INFO as a first-class recall state (tool-study: morluto/rea).** REA requires: "Unresolved identity or applicability must remain unknown rather than be treated as absent, foreign, or aligned," and its issue reports use "NOT_ENOUGH_INFO with an explanation" for missing evidence. Memory recall must surface "no evidence" as UNDECIDED with a reason — never as negative evidence. Calibrates the "undecided" response and formalizes our honest-negative discipline as a recall state, not just a research posture. (tool-study: morluto/rea AGENTS.md, read 2026-10-18) — HIGH

### 1508.

**Rebound-identifier binding check at recall time (tool-study: morluto/rea).** REA's law — "a PID and executable path alone do not establish ownership after exit or reuse" — is our rebound-identifier trap stated as engineering doctrine. Design rule: identifier match alone never establishes live binding; every binding recall must re-verify the binding against a live signal (authority, recency, provenance) before the record is used. A key that was valid can be rebound to a new entity. This converts the trap from an adversarial finding into a standing controller gate. (tool-study: morluto/rea AGENTS.md, read 2026-10-18) — HIGH

### 1509.

**Single-owner interpretation rule for derivations (tool-study: morluto/rea).** REA: "Consumers must use that owner's parsed facts rather than reinterpret raw source." Store each derivation once with its owner and provenance; retrieval returns the owned parse — consumers never re-derive from raw evidence at read time. Prevents contradiction-by-reinterpretation, the mechanism behind our dedup-eats-contradictions concern (R169 quarantine precedent: when two owned interpretations collide, quarantine — don't merge blindly). (tool-study: morluto/rea AGENTS.md, read 2026-10-18) — MEDIUM

### 1510.

**Playbook packaging for memory procedures (tool-study: morluto/rea).** Package every memory retrieval/write playbook like an REA skill pack (issue #43): intended questions and prerequisites, scope/authorization checks, staged workflow with budgets and stopping conditions, evidence and confidence requirements, side effects and approval gates, expected artifacts and report schema, explicit residual unknowns. A playbook without a declared budget, stopping condition, or residual-unknowns field is incomplete — not ready for the controller to execute. This is the write-path-gate spec in implementable form. (tool-study: morluto/rea issue #43, read 2026-10-18) — HIGH

### 1511.

**Residual-unknowns review as a first-class memory routine (tool-study: morluto/rea).** REA ships "residual-unknowns review and next-probe selection" as an actual skill pack. Implement the equivalent as a standing memory routine: periodically review what the memory system does NOT know (declared unknowns across entries), and select the next probe — what to verify, what to refresh, what to retire. This is the "doubt" stage of the human-like decision loop (propose → deliberate → doubt → commit), operationalized as scheduled unknown-review rather than exception-driven anomaly detection. (tool-study: morluto/rea issue #43, read 2026-10-18) — MEDIUM

### 1512.

**Semantic-intent storage for learned procedures + minimal-sufficient retrieval (tool-study: morluto/rea).** Two transfers, one idea: (a) learned memory procedures store semantic capability intent, not hard-coded mechanism text — REA skills "call semantic capabilities, not hard-coded provider commands," because mechanism rots and intent survives; (b) retrieval returns the smallest sufficient answer with necessary provenance, coverage, and limitations — REA's token discipline — which is the context-packing doctrine: recall budget is spent on provenance-bearing essentials, not bulk dump. Together: memory holds intent-graded procedures and returns provenance-graded answers. (tool-study: morluto/rea AGENTS.md+issue #43, read 2026-10-18) — MEDIUM
